title.zh: 卷五 本紀第五 文帝
title.raw: 卷五 本紀第五 文帝 Volume 5 Annals 5: Emperor Wen

sentences.zh: 景平二年七月中，少帝廢。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the second year of Jingping, the young emperor was deposed.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of Jingping, the young emperor was deposed.

sentences.zh: 百官備法駕奉迎，入奉皇統。

translations.literal: The hundred officials prepared the imperial carriage and escort to welcome him, and he entered to receive the imperial succession.
translations.idiomatic: The officials arrayed the imperial carriage and escort to receive him, and he came forward to assume the imperial succession.

sentences.zh: 行臺至江陵，進璽紱。

translations.literal: When the mobile secretariat reached Jiangling, they presented the imperial seal and ribbon.
translations.idiomatic: When the mobile secretariat reached Jiangling, the imperial seal and ribbon were presented.

sentences.zh: 侍中臣琇、散騎常侍臣嶷之、中書監尚書令護軍將軍建城縣公臣亮、左衞將軍臣景仁、給事中游擊將軍龍鄉縣侯臣隆、越騎校尉都亭侯臣綱、給事黃門侍郎臣孔璩之、散騎侍郎臣劉思考、員外散騎侍郎臣潘盛、中書侍郎臣何尚之、羽林監封陽縣開國侯臣蕭思話、長兼尚書左丞德陽縣侯臣孫康、吏部郎中騎都尉臣張茂度、儀曹郎中臣徐長琳、倉部郎中臣庾俊之、都官郎中臣袁洵等上表曰：「臣聞否泰相革，數窮則變，天道所以不謟，卜世所以靈長。

translations.literal: Attendant-in-ordinary Chen Qiu, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Chen Yanzhi, Director of the Secretariat, Minister of the Secretariat, Protector of the Army, General of the Household, Duke of Jiancheng County Chen Liang, General of the Left Guard Chen Jingren, Colonel of the Garrison Cavalry of the Palace Secretariat, Marquis of Longxiang County Chen Long, Colonel of the Fleet Cavalry, Marquis of Duting Chen Gang, Gentleman-Attendant of the Yellow Gate Chen Kong Zhizhi, Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Liu Sikao, Supernumerary Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Pan Sheng, Gentleman of the Secretariat He Shangzhi, Supervisor of the Forest of Feathers, Marquis Who Opens a State at Fengyang County Xiao Sihua, Acting Left Director of the Secretariat, Marquis of Deyang County Sun Kang, Director of the Ministry of Personnel, Commandant of Cavalry Zhang Maodu, Director of the Bureau of Rites Xu Changlin, Director of the Bureau of Granaries Yu Junzhi, Director of the Bureau of Justice Yuan Xun, and others submitted a memorial, saying: "Your subjects have heard that adversity and prosperity transform each other, and when numbers reach their limit change follows; this is why the Way of Heaven does not grow stale, and why divined dynastic fortune endures so long."
translations.idiomatic: Attendant-in-ordinary Chen Qiu, Regular Attendant Chen Yanzhi, Director of the Secretariat Chen Liang, Duke of Jiancheng, General of the Left Guard Chen Jingren, Colonel of the Garrison Cavalry and Marquis of Longxiang Chen Long, Colonel of the Fleet Cavalry and Marquis of Duting Chen Gang, Gentleman-Attendant of the Yellow Gate Chen Kong Zhizhi, Regular Attendant Liu Sikao, Supernumerary Regular Attendant Pan Sheng, Gentleman of the Secretariat He Shangzhi, Supervisor of the Forest of Feathers and Marquis of Fengyang Xiao Sihua, Acting Left Director of the Secretariat and Marquis of Deyang Sun Kang, Director of the Ministry of Personnel and Commandant of Cavalry Zhang Maodu, Director of the Bureau of Rites Xu Changlin, Director of the Bureau of Granaries Yu Junzhi, Director of the Bureau of Justice Yuan Xun, and others submitted a memorial: "We have heard that fortune and misfortune turn upon one another, and that when a cycle reaches its end, change must come — this is why Heaven's way never grows stale and why a dynasty's ordained span may endure."

sentences.zh: 乃者運距陵夷，王室艱晦，九服之命，靡所適歸，高祖之業，將墜于地。

translations.literal: Recently the age's fortune encountered decline, the royal house fell into hardship and obscurity, the commands of the nine domains had nowhere to go, and the founding emperor's enterprise was about to fall to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: Of late the times had turned adverse, the royal house languished in hardship, the allegiance of the realm had nowhere to settle, and the founding emperor's legacy seemed ready to collapse.

sentences.zh: 賴基厚德深，人神同奬，社稷以寧，有生獲乂。

translations.literal: Relying on your profound virtue and deep foundation, men and spirits alike lent their support, the altars of state were thereby secured, and the living received order and peace.
translations.idiomatic: By your profound virtue and deep roots, men and spirits alike gave their support, the altars of state were secured, and the people found peace.

sentences.zh: 伏惟陛下君德自然，聖明在御，孝悌著於家邦，風猷宣於蕃牧。

translations.literal: We respectfully consider that Your Majesty's sovereign virtue is natural, sagely brilliance holds the throne, filial piety and brotherly duty shine in the clan and state, and your influence and teachings are proclaimed in the frontier provinces.
translations.idiomatic: We respectfully observe that Your Majesty's sovereign virtue is innate, your sagely brilliance holds the throne, filial piety and brotherly duty distinguish your house and realm, and your influence reaches even the frontier provinces.

sentences.zh: 是以徵祥雜沓，符瑞㸌煇。

translations.literal: Therefore auspicious signs came in profusion, and talismanic omens blazed with splendor.
translations.idiomatic: Hence auspicious signs multiplied, and portents blazed forth in splendor.

sentences.zh: 宗廟神靈，乃眷西顧，萬邦黎獻，望景託生。

translations.literal: The spirits of the ancestral temples turned their regard to the west, the myriad states and all peoples lifted their eyes to your radiance and entrusted their lives to you.
translations.idiomatic: The spirits of the ancestral temples turned westward in favor, and all the lands and peoples looked to your radiance and entrusted themselves to your rule.

sentences.zh: 臣等忝荷朝列，豫充將命，復集休明之運，再覩太平之業。

translations.literal: We and others are honored to bear posts at court, privileged to fulfill this mission, again gathered in an age of splendid brilliance, and once more beholding the enterprise of great peace.
translations.idiomatic: We who bear office at court are honored to fulfill this mission, gathered once more in an age of splendor and again witnessing the advent of great peace.

sentences.zh: 行臺至止，瞻望城闕，不勝喜說鳧藻之情，謹詣門拜表以聞。

translations.literal: The mobile secretariat has arrived and halted; gazing upon the capital walls, we cannot overcome our joy and the feeling of ducks on duckweed — we respectfully come to the gate to bow and submit this memorial to inform you.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the mobile secretariat has arrived and we gaze upon the capital walls, we cannot contain our joy; we respectfully come to the gate to bow and submit this memorial.

sentences.zh: 」上答曰：「皇運艱弊，數鍾屯夷，仰惟崇基，感尋國故，永慕厥躬，悲慨交集。

translations.literal: The Emperor replied: "The imperial fortune has been hard pressed, the number of our age has struck repeated adversity; looking up to the lofty foundation, I feel and seek the state's past, forever mourning that person, grief and indignation interweaving."
translations.idiomatic: The Emperor replied: "The imperial fortune has been sorely tried, and our age has met repeated adversity. Looking up to the lofty foundation, I mourn the past of the state and grieve for him without cease, grief and indignation mingling together."

sentences.zh: 賴七百祚永，股肱忠賢，故能休否以泰，天人式序。

translations.literal: Relying on the seven hundred years of enduring fortune, and on loyal and worthy arms and legs of the throne, we were therefore able to turn adversity into prosperity and order Heaven and men.
translations.idiomatic: By the seven hundred years of enduring fortune and by loyal, worthy servants of the throne, adversity was turned to prosperity and Heaven and men were set in order.

sentences.zh: 猥以不德，謬降大命，顧己兢悸，何以克堪。

translations.literal: I am unworthy and have wrongly received the great mandate; looking back on myself I tremble with fear — how could I bear it?
translations.idiomatic: Unworthy as I am, I have wrongly received the great mandate; looking back on myself I tremble with fear — how could I bear such a burden?

sentences.zh: 輒當暫歸朝庭，展哀陵寢，并與賢彥申寫所懷。

translations.literal: I shall for the time being return to the court, display mourning at the imperial tombs, and together with worthy ministers set forth what is in our hearts.
translations.idiomatic: I shall presently return to court, pay mourning rites at the imperial tombs, and together with worthy ministers lay bare what is in our hearts.

sentences.zh: 望體其心，勿為辭費。

translations.literal: I hope you will enter into my feelings and do not make excessive polite refusals.
translations.idiomatic: I hope you will understand my heart and spare me excessive polite refusals.

sentences.zh: 」府州佐史並稱臣，請題牓諸門，一依宮省，上不許。

translations.literal: The aides and clerks of the prefecture and province all styled themselves subjects and requested that placards be inscribed on the various gates, all according to the palace standards; the Emperor did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: The prefectural and provincial aides and clerks all styled themselves subjects and asked that placards be inscribed on every gate according to palace standards; the Emperor did not consent.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，發江陵。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, he departed from Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, he set out from Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 八月丙申，車駕至京城。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen of the eighth month, the imperial carriage reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the eighth month, the imperial carriage reached the capital.

sentences.zh: [1]丁酉，謁初寧陵，還於中堂即皇帝位。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, he paid homage at the Chuning Mausoleum, returned to the central hall, and there assumed the imperial throne.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, he paid homage at the Chuning Mausoleum, returned to the central hall, and there took the imperial throne.

sentences.zh: 元嘉元年秋八月丁酉，大赦天下，改景平二年為元嘉元年。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou of the eighth month in autumn of the first year of Yuanjia, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and the second year of Jingping was changed to the first year of Yuanjia.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the eighth month of autumn in the first year of Yuanjia, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and the second year of Jingping was renamed the first year of Yuanjia.

sentences.zh: 文武賜位二等，逋租宿債勿復收。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted two ranks of advancement; overdue rents and old debts were not to be collected again.
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were advanced two ranks; overdue rents and old debts were forgiven.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以行撫軍將軍、荊州刺史謝晦為撫軍將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengzi, Acting Pacifying-Army General and Governor of Jing Province Xie Hui was appointed Pacifying-Army General and Governor of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Acting Pacifying-Army General and Governor of Jing Province Xie Hui was confirmed as Pacifying-Army General and Governor of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，司空、錄尚書事、揚州刺史徐羨之進位司徒，衞將軍、江州刺史王弘進位司空，中書監、護軍將軍傅亮加左光祿大夫、開府儀同三司，撫軍將軍、荊州刺史謝晦進號衞將軍，鎮北將軍、南兗州刺史檀道濟進號征北將軍。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Minister of Works, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and Governor of Yang Province Xu Xianzhi was advanced to Grand Minister, Defender General and Governor of Jiang Province Wang Hong was advanced to Minister of Works, Director of the Secretariat and Protector of the Army Fu Liang was given the additional title of Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Opening of an Office with Equipage Equal to the Three Excellencies, Pacifying-Army General and Governor of Jing Province Xie Hui was given the additional title of Defender General, and Pacifying-North General and Governor of Southern Yan Province Tan Daoji was given the additional title of Campaigning-North General.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Minister of Works Xu Xianzhi was advanced to Grand Minister, Defender General Wang Hong to Minister of Works, Director of the Secretariat Fu Liang was given the additional title of Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with an office equal to the Three Excellencies, Pacifying-Army General Xie Hui was made Defender General, and Pacifying-North General Tan Daoji was made Campaigning-North General.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，追尊所生胡婕妤為皇太后，諡曰章后。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen, his biological mother, Lady Hu the Brilliant Consort, was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager with the temple name Empress Zhang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, his biological mother, Lady Hu the Brilliant Consort, was posthumously honored as Empress Dowager with the temple name Empress Zhang.

sentences.zh: 衞將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康進號驃騎將軍，冠軍將軍、南豫州刺史義恭進號撫軍將軍，封江夏王。

translations.literal: Defender General and Governor of Southern Xu Province, Prince of Pengcheng Liu Yikang, was given the additional title of Rapid Cavalry General; Champion General and Governor of Southern Yu Province Liu Yigong was given the additional title of Pacifying-Army General and enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.
translations.idiomatic: Defender General and Governor of Southern Xu Province, Prince of Pengcheng Liu Yikang, was made Rapid Cavalry General; Champion General Liu Yigong was made Pacifying-Army General and enfeoffed as Prince of Jiangxia.

sentences.zh: 立第六皇弟義宣為竟陵王，第七皇弟義季為衡陽王。

translations.literal: The sixth younger imperial brother Yixuan was established as Prince of Jingling, and the seventh younger imperial brother Yiji as Prince of Hengyang.
translations.idiomatic: The sixth younger imperial brother Yixuan was enfeoffed as Prince of Jingling, and the seventh, Yiji, as Prince of Hengyang.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以豫州刺史劉粹為雍州刺史，驍騎將軍管義之為豫州刺史，南蠻校尉到彥之為中領軍。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Governor of Yu Province Liu Cui was appointed Governor of Yong Province, Rapid-Cavalry General Guan Yizhi was appointed Governor of Yu Province, and Colonel of the Southern Barbarians Dao Yanzhi was appointed Central Commander of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Governor of Yu Province Liu Cui was made Governor of Yong Province, Rapid-Cavalry General Guan Yizhi Governor of Yu Province, and Colonel of the Southern Barbarians Dao Yanzhi Central Commander of the Army.

sentences.zh: 己酉，減荊、湘二州今年稅布之半。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, this year's tax cloth in Jing and Xiang provinces was reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, this year's tax cloth in Jing and Xiang provinces was reduced by half.

sentences.zh: 九月丙子，立妃袁氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi of the ninth month, Consort Yuan was established as Empress.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the ninth month, Consort Yuan was established as Empress.

sentences.zh: 二年春正月丙寅，司徒徐羨之、尚書令傅亮奉表歸政，上始親覽。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the second year, on the day bingyin, Grand Minister Xu Xianzhi and Minister of the Secretariat Fu Liang submitted a memorial returning government to the throne, and the Emperor for the first time personally reviewed affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the second year, on bingyin, Grand Minister Xu Xianzhi and Minister of the Secretariat Fu Liang submitted a memorial restoring government to the throne, and the Emperor for the first time personally attended to affairs of state.

sentences.zh: 辛未，車駕祠南郊，[2]大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the imperial carriage performed sacrifice at the southern suburb, and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the Emperor sacrificed at the southern suburb and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，左將軍、徐州刺史王仲德進號安北將軍。

translations.literal: On the day yichou of the third month, General of the Left and Governor of Xu Province Wang Zhongde was given the additional title of Pacifying-North General.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the third month, General of the Left and Governor of Xu Province Wang Zhongde was made Pacifying-North General.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊寅，特進謝澹卒。

translations.literal: In summer, on the day wuyin of the fifth month, Special Grand Master Xie Dan died.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on wuyin in the fifth month, Special Grand Master Xie Dan died.

sentences.zh: 秋八月甲申，以關中流民出漢川，置京兆、扶風、馮翊等郡。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen of the eighth month in autumn, because refugees from the Guanzhong region had come out to the Han River basin, the commanderies of Jingzhao, Fufeng, and Fengyi were established.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen in the eighth month of autumn, because refugees from the Guanzhong region had settled along the Han River, the commanderies of Jingzhao, Fufeng, and Fengyi were established.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，驃騎將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康為開府儀同三司，新除司空王弘為車騎大將軍、開府儀同三司，以右軍長史江恒為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Rapid-Cavalry General and Governor of Southern Xu Province, Prince of Pengcheng Liu Yikang, was made Opening of an Office with Equipage Equal to the Three Excellencies; the newly appointed Minister of Works Wang Hong was made Grand General of the Chariots and Cavalry with an office equal to the Three Excellencies; Senior Clerk of the Right Army Jiang Heng was appointed Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Rapid-Cavalry General and Prince of Pengcheng Liu Yikang was given an office equal to the Three Excellencies; the newly appointed Minister of Works Wang Hong was made Grand General of the Chariots and Cavalry with equal privilege; Senior Clerk of the Right Army Jiang Heng was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月癸酉，以前將軍楊玄為征西將軍、北秦州刺史。

translations.literal: In winter, on the day guiyou of the eleventh month, former General of the Van Yang Xuan was appointed Campaigning-West General and Governor of Northern Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on guiyou in the eleventh month, former General of the Van Yang Xuan was appointed Campaigning-West General and Governor of Northern Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 三年春正月丙寅，司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史徐羨之，尚書令、護軍將軍、左光祿大夫傅亮，有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the third year, on the day bingyin, Grand Minister, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and Governor of Yang Province Xu Xianzhi, and Minister of the Secretariat, Protector of the Army, and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Fu Liang, were guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the third year, on bingyin, Grand Minister Xu Xianzhi and Minister of the Secretariat Fu Liang were found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 遣中領軍到彥之、征北將軍檀道濟討荊州刺史謝晦，上親率六師西征。

translations.literal: Central Commander of the Army Dao Yanzhi and Campaigning-North General Tan Daoji were sent to attack Governor of Jing Province Xie Hui; the Emperor personally led the six armies on a western campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Central Commander of the Army Dao Yanzhi and Campaigning-North General Tan Daoji were dispatched to attack Governor of Jing Province Xie Hui; the Emperor personally led the six armies westward.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，以車騎大將軍、江州刺史王弘為司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史，驃騎將軍、南徐州刺史彭城王義康改為荊州刺史，撫軍將軍、南豫州刺史江夏王義恭改為南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao, Grand General of the Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jiang Province Wang Hong was appointed Grand Minister, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and Governor of Yang Province; Rapid-Cavalry General and Governor of Southern Xu Province, Prince of Pengcheng Liu Yikang, was changed to Governor of Jing Province; Pacifying-Army General and Governor of Southern Yu Province, Prince of Jiangxia Liu Yigong, was changed to Governor of Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao, Grand General of the Chariots and Cavalry Wang Hong was appointed Grand Minister and Governor of Yang Province; Rapid-Cavalry General and Prince of Pengcheng Liu Yikang was transferred to Governor of Jing Province; Pacifying-Army General and Prince of Jiangxia Liu Yigong to Governor of Southern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以前護軍將軍趙倫之為鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, former Protector of the Army Zhao Lunzhi was appointed Pacifying-Army General.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, former Protector of the Army Zhao Lunzhi was appointed Pacifying-Army General.

sentences.zh: 閏月丙戌，皇子劭生。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu of the intercalary month, the imperial son Shao was born.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu in the intercalary month, the imperial son Shao was born.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，繫囚見徒，一皆原赦。

translations.literal: On the day yimao of the second month, all prisoners awaiting trial were entirely pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the second month, all prisoners awaiting trial were fully pardoned.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以金紫光祿大夫王敬弘為尚書左僕射，豫章太守鄭鮮之為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Wang Jinghong was appointed Vice Director of the Left of the Secretariat, and Governor of Zhangzhang Zheng Xianzhi was appointed Vice Director of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Wang Jinghong was appointed Vice Director of the Left of the Secretariat, and Governor of Zhangzhang Zheng Xianzhi Vice Director of the Right.

sentences.zh: 建安太守潘盛有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: Governor of Jian'an Pan Sheng was guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Jian'an Pan Sheng was found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: [3]庚申，特進范泰加光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Special Grand Master Fan Tai was given the additional title of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Special Grand Master Fan Tai was given the additional title of Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 是日，車駕發京師。

translations.literal: On that day the imperial carriage departed from the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That same day the Emperor departed from the capital.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，到彥之、檀道濟大破謝晦於隱磯。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji inflicted a great defeat on Xie Hui at Yinji.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen, Dao Yanzhi and Tan Daoji inflicted a great defeat on Xie Hui at Yinji.

sentences.zh: 丙子，車駕自蕪湖反斾。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, the imperial carriage turned its banners back from Wuhu.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, the Emperor turned back from Wuhu.

sentences.zh: 己卯，擒晦於延頭，送京師伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day jimao, Hui was captured at Yantou, sent to the capital, and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao, Hui was captured at Yantou, sent to the capital, and executed.

sentences.zh: 三月辛巳，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi in the third month, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 夏五月乙未，以征北將軍、南兗州刺史檀道濟為征南大將軍、江州刺史，中領軍到彥之為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In summer, on the day yiwei of the fifth month, Campaigning-North General and Governor of Southern Yan Province Tan Daoji was appointed Campaigning-South Grand General and Governor of Jiang Province, and Central Commander of the Army Dao Yanzhi was appointed Governor of Southern Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on yiwei in the fifth month, Campaigning-North General Tan Daoji was made Campaigning-South Grand General and Governor of Jiang Province, and Central Commander of the Army Dao Yanzhi Governor of Southern Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，以後將軍長沙王義欣為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Rear General and Prince of Changsha Liu Yixin was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Rear General and Prince of Changsha Liu Yixin was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，驃騎大將軍、涼州牧大沮渠蒙遜改為車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day yisi, Rapid-Cavalry Grand General and Governor of Liang Province, Great King Juqu Mengxun of Northern Liang, was changed to Grand General of the Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi, Rapid-Cavalry Grand General and Governor of Liang Province, King Juqu Mengxun of Northern Liang, was demoted to Grand General of the Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 詔曰：「夫哲王宰世，廣達四聰，猶巡嶽省方，採風觀政。

translations.literal: An edict said: "When a sage king governs the age, he broadly extends his four keen ears, yet still tours the sacred mountains and inspects the regions, gathering wind and observing government."
translations.idiomatic: An edict said: "When a sage king governs the world, he extends his keen hearing in every direction, yet still tours the sacred mountains and inspects the regions, gathering reports and observing how government is conducted."

sentences.zh: 所以情偽必審，幽遐罔滯，王澤無擁，九皐有聞者也。

translations.literal: By this means truth and falsehood are surely examined, the remote and hidden are not neglected, royal favor is not blocked, and the nine marshes have those who hear.
translations.idiomatic: Thus truth and falsehood are surely sifted, the remote and hidden are not neglected, royal favor reaches everywhere, and word of grievance rises from the farthest corners.

sentences.zh: 朕以寡薄，猥纂洪緒。

translations.literal: I, with my paltry virtue, have presumptuously succeeded to the great succession.
translations.idiomatic: I, of paltry virtue, have presumptuously succeeded to the great succession.

sentences.zh: 雖永念治道，志存昧旦，願言傅巖，發想宵寐，而丘園之秀，藏器未臻，物情民隱，尚隔視聽。

translations.literal: Though I forever bear governance in mind and my intent dwells before dawn, though I long for Fu Yue's cliff and rise from sleep with that thought, yet the worthy in hill and garden, their talents still unrevealed, and the people's hidden circumstances remain cut off from my sight and hearing.
translations.idiomatic: Though I forever bear governance in mind and rise before dawn with intent fixed upon worthy counsel, the reclusive talents of hill and garden remain unrevealed, and the people's hidden circumstances still lie beyond my sight and hearing.

sentences.zh: 乃眷區域，輟寢忘飡。

translations.literal: Therefore regarding the realm I have set aside sleep and forgotten meals.
translations.idiomatic: For the sake of the realm I have set aside sleep and forgotten my meals.

sentences.zh: 今氛祲袪蕩，宇內寧晏，旌賢弘化，於是乎始。

translations.literal: Now the baleful vapors have been swept away, the realm within the four seas is tranquil, and to raise the worthy and spread transformation begins from this moment.
translations.idiomatic: Now the baleful vapors have been swept away and the realm is tranquil; to raise the worthy and spread enlightened rule begins from this moment.

sentences.zh: 可遣大使巡行四方。

translations.literal: Grand envoys may be dispatched to tour the four quarters.
translations.idiomatic: Grand envoys may be dispatched to tour the four quarters.

sentences.zh: 其宰守稱職之良，閨蓽一介之善，詳悉列奏，勿或有遺。

translations.literal: Those prefects and magistrates who are capable, and worthies of humble station however slight their merit, are to be set forth in full detail in memorials, and nothing is to be omitted.
translations.idiomatic: Capable prefects and magistrates, and worthies of the humblest station however slight their merit, are to be reported in full detail, and nothing omitted.

sentences.zh: 若刑獄不卹，政治乖謬，傷民害教者，具以事聞。

translations.literal: Where punishments and prisons show no compassion, where government is perverse and mistaken, or where the people are harmed and teaching injured, the facts are to be reported in full.
translations.idiomatic: Where punishments and prisons lack compassion, where government errs, or where the people are harmed and teaching injured, the facts are to be reported in full.

sentences.zh: 其高年、鰥寡、幼孤、六疾不能自存者，可與郡縣優量賑給。

translations.literal: As for the elderly, widowers, orphans, the young and orphaned, and the six kinds of infirmity who cannot support themselves, relief may be measured out generously with the commanderies and counties.
translations.idiomatic: As for the elderly, widowers, orphans, the young without support, and those suffering the six kinds of infirmity who cannot sustain themselves, the commanderies and counties should measure out generous relief.

sentences.zh: 博採輿誦，廣納嘉謀，務盡銜命之旨，俾若朕親覽焉。

translations.literal: Broadly gather popular reports, widely receive excellent counsel, and strive to exhaust the intent of your commission, as though I myself were reviewing it.
translations.idiomatic: Gather popular reports broadly, receive excellent counsel widely, and strive to exhaust the intent of your commission, as though I myself were reviewing it.

sentences.zh: 」丙午，車駕臨延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day bingwu, the imperial carriage came to the Hall for Honoring the Worthy to hear cases.
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu, the Emperor came to the Hall for Honoring the Worthy to hear cases.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，以鎮軍將軍趙倫之為左光祿大夫、領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei of the sixth month, Pacifying-Army General Zhao Lunzhi was appointed Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Commander of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the sixth month, Pacifying-Army General Zhao Lunzhi was appointed Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Commander of the Army.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，車駕又於延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, the imperial carriage again came to the Hall for Honoring the Worthy to hear cases.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, the Emperor again came to the Hall for Honoring the Worthy to hear cases.

sentences.zh: 丙子，又聽訟。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi, he again heard cases.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi, he again heard cases.

sentences.zh: 以右衞王華為中護軍。

translations.literal: The Prince of the Right Guard Wang Hua was appointed Central Protector of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of the Right Guard Wang Hua was appointed Central Protector of the Army.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月戊寅，以梁、南秦二州刺史吉翰為益州刺史，驃騎參軍劉道產為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: In winter, on the day wuyin of the eleventh month, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces Ji Han was appointed Governor of Yi Province, and Rapid-Cavalry Staff Officer Liu Daochan was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on wuyin in the eleventh month, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin Ji Han was appointed Governor of Yi Province, and Rapid-Cavalry Staff Officer Liu Daochan Governor of Liang and Southern Qin.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以南蠻校尉劉遵考為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Colonel of the Southern Barbarians Liu Zunkao was appointed Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Colonel of the Southern Barbarians Liu Zunkao was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸丑，以中書侍郎蕭思話為青州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guichou of the twelfth month, Gentleman of the Secretariat Xiao Sihua was appointed Governor of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the twelfth month, Gentleman of the Secretariat Xiao Sihua was appointed Governor of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，前吳郡太守徐佩之謀反，及黨與皆伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, former Governor of Wu Commandery Xu Peizhi plotted rebellion; he and his associates were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu, former Governor of Wu Commandery Xu Peizhi plotted rebellion; he and his associates were all executed.

sentences.zh: 四年春正月乙亥朔，曲赦都邑百里內。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourth year, on the first day yihai of the month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed within a hundred li of the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the fourth year, on the new moon yihai, a partial amnesty was proclaimed within a hundred li of the capital.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, the imperial carriage in person performed sacrifice at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, the Emperor in person sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月乙卯，行幸丹徒，謁京陵。

translations.literal: On the day yimao of the second month, he traveled to Dantu and paid homage at the Jing Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao in the second month, he traveled to Dantu and paid homage at the Jing Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 三月丙子，詔曰：「丹徒桑梓綢繆，大業攸始，踐境永懷，觸感罔極。

translations.literal: On the day bingzi of the third month, an edict said: "Dantu is bound to me by ties of native place; the great enterprise began from there — treading that soil I am forever mindful, and touched by it my feeling knows no limit."
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi in the third month, an edict said: "Dantu is bound to me by native ties; the great enterprise began there — treading that soil I am forever mindful, and touched by it my feeling knows no limit."

sentences.zh: 昔漢章南巡，加恩元氏，況情義二三，有兼曩日。

translations.literal: In former times Emperor Zhang of Han on his southern tour added favor to the Yuan clan; how much more when affection and obligation are doubled, as on those former days.
translations.idiomatic: In former times Emperor Zhang of Han on his southern tour added favor to the Yuan clan; how much more when present affection and obligation are doubled, as in those former days.

sentences.zh: 思播遺澤，酬慰士民。

translations.literal: I think to spread the lingering bounty and repay and comfort the gentry and people.
translations.idiomatic: I mean to spread lingering bounty and repay and comfort the gentry and people.

sentences.zh: 其蠲此縣今年租布，五歲刑以下皆悉原遣；

translations.literal: This county's tax cloth for this year is to be remitted; all punishments of five years or less are entirely pardoned and released.
translations.idiomatic: This county's tax cloth for this year is to be remitted; all punishments of five years or less are to be fully pardoned.

sentences.zh: 登城三戰及大將家，隨宜隱卹。

translations.literal: Those who fought three battles in the assault on the city and the households of great generals are to receive condolence and relief as appropriate.
translations.idiomatic: Those who fought three assaults on the walls and the households of great generals are to receive condolence and relief as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 」丁亥，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 戊子，尚書右僕射鄭鮮之卒。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Vice Director of the Right of the Secretariat Zheng Xianzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Vice Director of the Right of the Secretariat Zheng Xianzhi died.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，禁斷夏至日五絲命縷之屬，富陽令諸葛闡之之議也。

translations.literal: On the day renyin, the making at the summer solstice of five-colored silk life-cords and the like was forbidden — this was the proposal of Magistrate of Fuyang Zhuge Kanzhi.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin, the making at the summer solstice of five-colored silk life-cords and the like was forbidden — a proposal of Magistrate of Fuyang Zhuge Kanzhi.

sentences.zh: 夏四月庚戌，以廷尉王徽之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In summer, on the day gengxu of the fourth month, Director of the Court of Justice Wang Huizhi was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on gengxu in the fourth month, Director of the Court of Justice Wang Huizhi was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 五月壬午，中護軍王華卒。

translations.literal: On the day renwu of the fifth month, Central Protector of the Army Wang Hua died.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the fifth month, Central Protector of the Army Wang Hua died.

sentences.zh: 京師疾疫，甲午，遣使存問，給醫藥；

translations.literal: An epidemic struck the capital; on the day jiawu, envoys were sent to inquire after the people and provide medicines.
translations.idiomatic: An epidemic struck the capital; on jiawu, envoys were sent to inquire after the people and provide medicines.

sentences.zh: 死者若無家屬，賜以棺器。

translations.literal: If the dead had no family members, coffins and burial goods were bestowed upon them.
translations.idiomatic: Where the dead had no family, coffins and burial goods were provided.

sentences.zh: 六月癸卯朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day guimao of the sixth month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon guimao in the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 庚申，以金紫光祿大夫殷穆為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Golden Seal and Purple Ribbon Yin Mu was appointed Protector of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Yin Mu was appointed Protector of the Army.

sentences.zh: 五年春正月乙亥，詔曰：「朕恭承洪業，臨饗四海，風化未弘，治道多昧，求之人事，鑒寐惟憂。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fifth year, on the day yihai, an edict said: "I respectfully receive the great enterprise and preside over feasting on the four seas; custom and transformation are not yet spread abroad, and the way of governance has many obscurities — seeking it in human affairs, whether waking or sleeping I have only worry."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the fifth year, on yihai, an edict said: "I respectfully bear the great enterprise and preside over the four seas; custom and transformation are not yet widespread, and the way of governance remains obscure — seeking remedy in human affairs, I wake and sleep in worry alone."

sentences.zh: 加頃陰陽違序，旱疫成患，仰惟災戒，責深在予。

translations.literal: Moreover, of late yin and yang have violated their proper order, drought and pestilence have become calamities; looking up to these warnings of disaster, the blame lies deep in me.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, of late yin and yang have lost their proper order, drought and pestilence have become calamities; looking up to these warnings, the blame lies deep in me.

sentences.zh: 思所以側身剋念，議獄詳刑，上答天譴，下恤民瘼。

translations.literal: I think how to turn my person, restrain my thoughts, deliberate on prisons and examine punishments, above to answer Heaven's reproof, below to comfort the people's afflictions.
translations.idiomatic: I consider how to examine myself, restrain my thoughts, deliberate on prisons and examine punishments, above to answer Heaven's reproof and below to ease the people's afflictions.

sentences.zh: 羣后百司，其各獻讜言，指陳得失，勿有所諱。

translations.literal: The hundred officials of the host of ministers, each of you is to present loyal words, point out gains and losses, and do not hold anything back.
translations.idiomatic: You ministers and officials, each present loyal counsel, point out what is right and wrong, and hold nothing back.

sentences.zh: 」甲申，車駕臨玄武館閱武。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the imperial carriage came to the Black Tortoise Hall to review martial displays.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the Emperor came to the Black Tortoise Hall to review martial displays.

sentences.zh: 戊子，京邑大火，遣使巡慰賑賜。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, a great fire broke out in the capital; envoys were sent to tour and comfort and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, a great fire broke out in the capital; envoys were sent to tour the districts, comfort the people, and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己亥，以南蠻校尉蕭摹之為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: In summer, on the day jihai of the fourth month, Colonel of the Southern Barbarians Xiao Muzhi was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on jihai in the fourth month, Colonel of the Southern Barbarians Xiao Muzhi was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以始興太守徐豁為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Governor of Shixing Xu Huo was appointed Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Governor of Shixing Xu Huo was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，以湘州刺史張邵為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jimao of the fifth month, Governor of Xiang Province Zhang Shao was appointed Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the fifth month, Governor of Xiang Province Zhang Shao was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，司徒王弘降為衞將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu of the sixth month, Grand Minister Wang Hong was reduced to Defender General with an office equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the sixth month, Grand Minister Wang Hong was demoted to Defender General with an office equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 京邑大水，乙卯，[4]遣使檢行賑贍。

translations.literal: Great floods struck the capital; on the day yimao, envoys were sent to inspect and grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: Great floods struck the capital; on yimao, envoys were sent to inspect the damage and grant relief.

sentences.zh: 以江夏內史程道惠為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: Interior Minister of Jiangxia Cheng Daohui was appointed Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Interior Minister of Jiangxia Cheng Daohui was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 秋八月壬戌，特進、左光祿大夫范泰卒。

translations.literal: On the day renxu of the eighth month in autumn, Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Fan Tai died.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the eighth month of autumn, Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Fan Tai died.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲辰，車駕於延賢堂聽訟。

translations.literal: In winter, on the day jiachen of the tenth month, the imperial carriage came to the Hall for Honoring the Worthy to hear cases.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on jiachen in the tenth month, the Emperor came to the Hall for Honoring the Worthy to hear cases.

sentences.zh: 閏月癸未，以右軍司馬劉德武為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei of the intercalary month, Senior Clerk of the Right Army Liu Dewu was appointed Governor of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the intercalary month, Senior Clerk of the Right Army Liu Dewu was appointed Governor of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，安陸公相周籍之為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Chancellor of Anling Zhou Jizhi was made Governor of Ning Province.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Chancellor of Anling Zhou Jizhi was appointed Governor of Ning Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月庚寅，左光祿大夫、領軍將軍趙倫之卒。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin of the twelfth month, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Commander of the Army Zhao Lunzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the twelfth month, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and Commander of the Army Zhao Lunzhi died.

sentences.zh: 是歲，天竺國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In this year the state of Tianzhu sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year the state of Tianzhu sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 六年春正月辛丑，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixth year, on the day xinchou, the imperial carriage in person performed sacrifice at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the sixth year, on xinchou, the Emperor in person sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以驃騎將軍、荊州刺史彭城王義康為司徒、錄尚書事，領平北將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Rapid-Cavalry General and Governor of Jing Province, Prince of Pengcheng Liu Yikang, was appointed Grand Minister, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and concurrently Pacifying-North General and Governor of Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Rapid-Cavalry General and Prince of Pengcheng Liu Yikang was appointed Grand Minister and Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and concurrently Pacifying-North General and Governor of Southern Xu Province.

translations.literal: Annotation marker 5.
translations.idiomatic: Textual annotation marker 5.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，立皇子劭為皇太子。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi of the third month, the imperial son Shao was established as Crown Prince.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi in the third month, the imperial son Shao was established as Crown Prince.

sentences.zh: 戊午，大赦天下，賜文武位一等。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were advanced one rank.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以左衞將軍殷景仁為中領軍。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, General of the Left Guard Yin Jingren was appointed Central Commander of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, General of the Left Guard Yin Jingren was appointed Central Commander of the Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸亥，以尚書左僕射王敬弘為尚書令，丹陽尹臨川王義慶為尚書左僕射，吏部尚書江夷為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In summer, on the day guihai of the fourth month, Vice Director of the Left of the Secretariat Wang Jinghong was appointed Minister of the Secretariat, Prince of Linchuan Liu Yiqing was appointed Vice Director of the Left, and Minister of the Ministry of Personnel Jiang Yi was appointed Vice Director of the Right.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on guihai in the fourth month, Vice Director of the Left Wang Jinghong was appointed Minister of the Secretariat, Prince of Linchuan Liu Yiqing Vice Director of the Left, and Minister of Personnel Jiang Yi Vice Director of the Right.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day renchen of the fifth month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon renchen in the fifth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以新除尚書令王敬弘為特進、左光祿大夫。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the newly appointed Minister of the Secretariat Wang Jinghong was made Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the newly appointed Minister of the Secretariat Wang Jinghong was made Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以撫軍司馬劉道濟為益州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Pacifying-Army Staff Officer Liu Daoji was appointed Governor of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Pacifying-Army Staff Officer Liu Daoji was appointed Governor of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，於雍州置馮翊郡。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, the commandery of Fengyi was established in Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the commandery of Fengyi was established in Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 七月己酉，以尚書左丞孔默之為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou of the seventh month, Left Director of the Secretariat Kong Mozhi was appointed Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the seventh month, Left Director of the Secretariat Kong Mozhi was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 是月，百濟王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In this month the king of Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That month the king of Baekje sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 九月戊午，於秦州置隴西、宋康二郡。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu of the ninth month, the commanderies of Longxi and Songkang were established in Qin Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the ninth month, the commanderies of Longxi and Songkang were established in Qin Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬申，中領軍殷景仁丁艱去職。

translations.literal: In winter, on the day renshen of the tenth month, Central Commander of the Army Yin Jingren, upon his father's death, left office.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on renshen in the tenth month, Central Commander of the Army Yin Jingren left office upon his father's death.

sentences.zh: 十一月己丑朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day jichou of the eleventh month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon jichou in the eleventh month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁亥，河南國、河西王遣使獻方物。

sentences.zh: 冬十一月壬子，以少府甄法崇為益州刺史。

translations.literal: In winter, on the day renzi of the eleventh month, Director of the Imperial Treasury Zhen Fachong was appointed Governor of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, on renzi in the eleventh month, Director of the Imperial Treasury Zhen Fachong was appointed Governor of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，於廣州立宋康郡。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, the commandery of Songkang was established in Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, the commandery of Songkang was established in Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月甲戌，以右軍參軍李秀之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu of the twelfth month, Right-Army Staff Officer Li Xiuzhi was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the twelfth month, Right-Army Staff Officer Li Xiuzhi was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，立第五皇子紹為廬陵王，江夏王義恭子朗為南豐縣王。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, the fifth prince, Shao, was enfeoffed as Prince of Luling, and Lang, son of Prince of Jiangxia Liu Yigong, as County Prince of Nanfeng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, the fifth prince Shao was enfeoffed as Prince of Luling, and Lang, son of Prince of Jiangxia Liu Yigong, as County Prince of Nanfeng.

sentences.zh: 十年春正月甲寅，竟陵王義宣改封南譙王。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the tenth year, on the day jiayin, Prince of Jingling Liu Yixuan was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Nanqiao.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the tenth year, on jiayin, Prince of Jingling Liu Yixuan was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Nanqiao.

sentences.zh: 鎮北將軍、徐州刺史王仲德加領兗州刺史，淮南太守段宏為青州刺史。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu Province Wang Zhongde was additionally appointed to serve as Governor of Yan Province, and Governor of Huainan Duan Hong was appointed Governor of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the North Wang Zhongde, Governor of Xu Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Yan Province, and Governor of Huainan Duan Hong was appointed Governor of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 己未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 孤老、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: Orphans and the elderly, and those suffering the six kinds of infirmity who could not support themselves, were each granted five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Orphans and the elderly, and those suffering the six kinds of infirmity who could not sustain themselves, each received five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 後將軍、豫州刺史長沙王義欣進號鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: Rear General and Governor of Yu Province, Prince of Changsha Liu Yixin, was advanced in rank to General Who Guards the Army.
translations.idiomatic: Rear General Liu Yixin, Prince of Changsha and Governor of Yu Province, was advanced to General Who Guards the Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊戌，青州刺史段宏加冀州刺史。

translations.literal: In summer, on the day wuxu of the fourth month, Governor of Qing Province Duan Hong was additionally appointed Governor of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on wuxu in the fourth month, Governor of Qing Province Duan Hong was additionally appointed Governor of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 封陽縣侯蕭思話為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: Marquis of Yangxian County Xiao Sihua was enfeoffed and appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Marquis of Yangxian Xiao Sihua was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 五月，林邑王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, the king of Linyi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, the king of Linyi sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 六月乙亥，以前青州刺史韋朗為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day yihai of the sixth month, former Governor of Qing Province Wei Lang was appointed Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai in the sixth month, former Governor of Qing Province Wei Lang was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 闍婆州訶羅單國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The state of Heluodan in Java sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Heluodan in Java sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，曲赦益、梁、秦三州。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day wuxu, a partial amnesty was proclaimed in the three provinces of Yi, Liang, and Qin.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuxu, a partial amnesty was proclaimed in Yi, Liang, and Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 於益州立宋寧、宋興二郡。

translations.literal: In Yi Province the two commanderies of Songning and Songxing were established.
translations.idiomatic: The commanderies of Songning and Songxing were established in Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 八月丁丑，於青州立太原郡。

translations.literal: On the day dingchou of the eighth month, the commandery of Taiyuan was established in Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou in the eighth month, the commandery of Taiyuan was established in Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，護軍將軍到彥之卒。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, Protector of the Army Dao Yanzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, Protector of the Army Dao Yanzhi died.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，氐楊難當寇漢川。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, the Di chieftain Yang Nandang raided the Han River region.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, the Di chieftain Yang Nandang raided the Han River region.

sentences.zh: 丁未，梁州刺史甄法護棄城走，難當據有梁州。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Governor of Liang Province Zhen Fahu abandoned the city and fled; Nandang seized Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Governor of Liang Province Zhen Fahu abandoned the city and fled, and Nandang took possession of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 十一年春正月，亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山，[13]州郡討平之。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the eleventh year, the outlaw Ma Daxuan and several hundred of his followers raided Mount Tai; [13] the provinces and commanderies suppressed and pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the eleventh year, the outlaw Ma Daxuan and several hundred followers raided Mount Tai; [13] the provincial and commandery forces suppressed them.

sentences.zh: 二月癸酉，以交阯太守李耽之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou of the second month, Governor of Jiaozhi Li Danzhi was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou in the second month, Governor of Jiaozhi Li Danzhi was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，梁、秦二州刺史蕭思話破氐楊難當，梁州平。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces Xiao Sihua defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nandang, and Liang Province was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, Governor of Liang and Southern Qin Xiao Sihua defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nandang, and Liang Province was pacified.

sentences.zh: 五月丁卯，曲赦梁、南秦二州劍閣北。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao of the fifth month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed north of Jian'ge in Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the fifth month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed north of Jian'ge in Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以大沮渠茂虔為征西大將軍、涼州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Juqu Maoqian of the Great Juqu clan was appointed Grand General Who Conquers the West and Governor of Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Juqu Maoqian of the Great Juqu was appointed Grand General Who Conquers the West and Governor of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 是月，京邑大水。

translations.literal: In this month, great floods struck the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: That month, great floods struck the capital region.

sentences.zh: 六月丁未，省魏郡。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei of the sixth month, Wei Commandery was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei in the sixth month, Wei Commandery was abolished.

sentences.zh: 是歲，林邑國、扶南國、訶羅單國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In this year, the states of Linyi, Funan, and Heluodan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the states of Linyi, Funan, and Heluodan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十二年春正月辛酉，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twelfth year, on the day xinyou, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the twelfth year, on xinyou, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 辛未，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, the imperial carriage personally performed sacrifice at the Southern Altar.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, the Emperor personally performed the southern suburb sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，封黃龍國主馮弘為燕王。

translations.literal: On the day guiyou, Feng Hong, lord of the state of Huanglong, was enfeoffed as King of Yan.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, Feng Hong, lord of Huanglong, was enfeoffed as King of Yan.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉，[14]尚書僕射殷景仁加中護軍。

translations.literal: In summer, on the day yiyou of the fourth month, [14] Vice Director of the Secretariat Yin Jingren was additionally appointed Central Protector of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on yiyou in the fourth month, [14] Vice Director of the Secretariat Yin Jingren was additionally appointed Central Protector of the Army.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，詔曰：「周宗以寧，實由多士，漢室之隆，亦資得人。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, an edict said: "The house of Zhou was secure through its many officers; the Han dynasty's flourishing likewise depended on gaining men of talent.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen, an edict said: "The house of Zhou endured through its many officers; the Han dynasty's flourishing likewise depended on gaining men of talent.

sentences.zh: 朕寐寤樂賢，為日已久，而則哲難階，明揚莫効。

translations.literal: We sleep and wake delighting in the worthy — this has lasted many days — yet discerning the sage proves hard to attain, and clear promotion yields no effect.
translations.idiomatic: We sleep and wake delighting in the worthy — this has lasted long — yet discerning the sage proves hard to attain, and clear promotion yields no effect.

sentences.zh: 用令遺才在野，管庫虛朝，永懷前載，慚德深矣。

translations.literal: Hence talents left in the wilds, granary and treasury offices stand empty at court — ever mindful of past records, our shame in virtue runs deep.
translations.idiomatic: Hence talents remain in the wilds, and granary and treasury offices stand empty at court — ever mindful of past ages, our shame in virtue runs deep.

sentences.zh: 夫舉爾所知，宣尼之篤訓，貢士任官，先代之成准。

translations.literal: To promote those you know — this is Confucius's earnest teaching; to present scholars and assign office is the established standard of former ages.
translations.idiomatic: To promote those you know is Confucius's earnest teaching; to present scholars and assign office is the established standard of former ages.

sentences.zh: 便可宣敕內外，各有薦舉。

translations.literal: Let an edict be proclaimed within and without; each should have recommendations.
translations.idiomatic: Let an edict be proclaimed throughout court and realm; each should submit recommendations.

sentences.zh: 當依方銓引，以觀厥用。

translations.literal: They should be selected and advanced according to their categories, to observe their employment.
translations.idiomatic: They should be selected and advanced according to their categories, to observe their employment.

sentences.zh: 」是夜，京都地震。

translations.literal: That night, the capital region suffered an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: That night, the capital region suffered an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 六月，丹陽、淮南、吳興、義興大水，京邑乘船。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, Danyang, Huainan, Wuxing, and Yixing suffered great floods; in the capital region, boats were used for travel.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Danyang, Huainan, Wuxing, and Yixing suffered great floods; in the capital region people traveled by boat.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以徐豫南兗三州、會稽宣城二郡米數百萬斛賜五郡遭水民。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou, several million hu of grain from the three provinces of Xu, Yu, and Southern Yan and the two commanderies of Kuaiji and Xuancheng were granted to the people of five commanderies afflicted by flood.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou, several million hu of grain from Xu, Yu, and Southern Yan provinces and Kuaiji and Xuancheng commanderies were granted to the people of five flood-afflicted commanderies.

sentences.zh: 是月，斷酒。

translations.literal: In this month, the sale of wine was prohibited.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the sale of wine was prohibited.

sentences.zh: 師子國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The state of Shizi sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Shizi sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉，[15]闍婆娑達國、扶南國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinyou, [15] the states of Zhanpozha and Funan both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinyou, [15] the states of Zhanpozha and Funan both sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月壬申，於益州立南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。

translations.literal: On the day renshen of the eighth month, the three commanderies of Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi were established in Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen in the eighth month, the commanderies of Southern Jinshou, Southern Xinba, and Northern Baxi were established in Yi Province.

sentences.zh: [16]乙亥，原遭水郡諸逋負。

translations.literal: [16] On the day yihai, all arrears in flood-afflicted commanderies were remitted.
translations.idiomatic: [16] On yihai, all arrears in flood-afflicted commanderies were remitted.

sentences.zh: 九月，蜀郡賊張尋為寇。

translations.literal: In the ninth month, the bandit Zhang Xun of Shu Commandery made raids.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month, the bandit Zhang Xun of Shu Commandery raided the region.

sentences.zh: 冬十一月，以右軍行參軍苟道覆為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of winter, Acting Staff Officer of the Right Army Gou Daofu was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of winter, Acting Staff Officer of the Right Army Gou Daofu was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 十三年春正月癸丑，上有疾，不朝會。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the thirteenth year, on the day guichou, the Emperor was ill and did not hold court audience.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the thirteenth year, on guichou, the Emperor was ill and did not hold court.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，司空、江州刺史檀道濟有罪伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei of the third month, Minister of Works and Governor of Jiang Province Tan Daoji was found guilty and executed.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the third month, Minister of Works Tan Daoji was found guilty and executed.

sentences.zh: 庚申，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 以中軍將軍南譙王義宣為鎮南將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: Central-Army General Prince of Nanqiao Liu Yixuan was appointed General Who Guards the South and Governor of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Central-Army General Liu Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao, was appointed General Who Guards the South and Governor of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 夏五月戊辰，鎮北將軍、徐兗二州刺史王仲德進號鎮北大將軍。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on the day wuchen, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces Wang Zhongde was advanced in rank to Grand General Who Pacifies the North.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on wuchen, General Who Pacifies the North Wang Zhongde, Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was advanced to Grand General Who Pacifies the North.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以征北司馬王方俳為兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Northern Campaigning Army Senior Clerk Wang Fangpai was appointed Governor of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Northern Campaigning Army Senior Clerk Wang Fangpai was appointed Governor of Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 六月，高麗國、武都王遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, the state of Goryeo and the King of Wudu sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Goryeo and the King of Wudu sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 八月庚寅，尚書僕射、中護軍殷景仁改為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin of the eighth month, Vice Director of the Secretariat and Central Protector of the Army Yin Jingren was changed to Protector of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the eighth month, Vice Director of the Secretariat Yin Jingren was reassigned from Central Protector of the Army to Protector of the Army.

sentences.zh: 九月癸丑，立第二皇子濬為始興王，第三皇子駿為武陵王。

translations.literal: On the day guichou of the ninth month, the second prince, Jun, was enfeoffed as Prince of Shixing, and the third prince, Jun, as Prince of Wuling.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the ninth month, the second prince Jun was enfeoffed as Prince of Shixing, and the third prince Jun as Prince of Wuling.

sentences.zh: 十四年春正月辛卯，車駕親祠南郊，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the fourteenth year, on the day xinmao, the imperial carriage personally performed sacrifice at the Southern Altar, and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the fourteenth year, on xinmao, the Emperor personally performed the southern suburb sacrifice and proclaimed a general amnesty throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 文武賜位一等；

translations.literal: Civil and military officials were granted one rank of advancement;
translations.idiomatic: Civil and military officials were advanced one rank;

sentences.zh: 孤老、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: Orphans and the elderly, and those suffering the six kinds of infirmity who could not support themselves, were each granted five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Orphans and the elderly, and those suffering the six kinds of infirmity who could not sustain themselves, each received five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 二月壬子，以步兵校尉劉真道為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renzi of the second month, Colonel of Footsoldiers Liu Zhendao was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the second month, Colonel of Footsoldiers Liu Zhendao was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

translations.literal: Annotation marker 17.
translations.idiomatic: Textual annotation marker 17.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，以輔國將軍周籍之為益州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day dingwei, General Who Assists the State Zhou Jizhi was appointed Governor of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingwei, General Who Assists the State Zhou Jizhi was appointed Governor of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 秋八月戊午，以尚書金部郎中徐森之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the day wuwu, Director of the Bureau of Gold of the Secretariat Xu Senzhi was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on wuwu, Director of the Bureau of Gold Xu Senzhi was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月辛酉，停賀雪。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on the day xinyou, the snow-congratulation ceremony was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on xinyou, the court suspended the snow-congratulation ceremony.

sentences.zh: 河南國、河西王、訶羅單國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: The state of Henan, the King of Hexi, and the state of Heluodan all sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: The state of Henan, the King of Hexi, and the state of Heluodan all sent envoys bearing tribute.

translations.literal: Annotation marker 18.
translations.idiomatic: Textual annotation marker 18.

sentences.zh: 十五年春二月丁未，以平東將軍吐谷渾慕容延為鎮西將軍、秦河二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the fifteenth year, on the day dingwei, General Who Pacifies the East Murong Yan of Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Qin and He provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring in the fifteenth year, on dingwei, General Who Pacifies the East Murong Yan of Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Qin and He provinces.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲辰，燕王弘遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jiachen, King Hong of Yan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiachen, King Hong of Yan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: [19]立皇太子妃殷氏，賜王公以下各有差。

translations.literal: [19] Lady Yin was installed as the crown prince's consort, and grants to princes, dukes, and below were made according to rank.
translations.idiomatic: [19] Lady Yin was installed as the crown prince's consort, and grants to princes, dukes, and those below were apportioned by rank.

sentences.zh: 己巳，以倭國王珍為安東將軍。

translations.literal: On the day jisi, King Zhen of Wa was appointed General Who Pacifies the East.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi, King Zhen of Wa was appointed General Who Pacifies the East.

sentences.zh: 五月己丑，特進、右光祿大夫殷穆卒。

translations.literal: On the day jichou of the fifth month, Special Grand Master and Right Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Yin Mu died.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou in the fifth month, Special Grand Master Yin Mu died.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，鎮北大將軍、徐州刺史王仲德卒。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, Grand General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu Province Wang Zhongde died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, Grand General Who Pacifies the North Wang Zhongde died.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以右衞將軍劉遵考為徐、兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, General of the Right Guard Liu Zunkao was appointed Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, General of the Right Guard Liu Zunkao was appointed Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，地震。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinwei, there was an earthquake.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei, there was an earthquake.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以陳、南頓二郡太守徐循為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, Governor of Chen and Nandun commanderies Xu Xun was appointed Governor of Ning Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, Governor of Chen and Nandun commanderies Xu Xun was appointed Governor of Ning Province.

sentences.zh: 八月辛丑，以左衞將軍趙伯符為徐、兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day xinchou of the eighth month, General of the Left Guard Zhao Bofu was appointed Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the eighth month, General of the Left Guard Zhao Bofu was appointed Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，以始興內史陸徽為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, Interior Minister of Shixing Lu Hui was appointed Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Interior Minister of Shixing Lu Hui was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，以兗州刺史王方俳為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, Governor of Yan Province Wang Fangpai was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, Governor of Yan Province Wang Fangpai was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 是歲，武都王、河南國、高麗國、倭國、扶南國、林邑國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In this year, the King of Wudu, the state of Henan, Goryeo, Wa, Funan, and Linyi all sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the King of Wudu, the state of Henan, Goryeo, Wa, Funan, and Linyi all sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十六年春正月戊寅，車駕於北郊閱武。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the sixteenth year, on the day wuyin, the imperial carriage reviewed martial displays at the Northern Suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the sixteenth year, on wuyin, the Emperor reviewed martial displays at the northern suburb.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，司徒、錄尚書事、揚州刺史彭城王義康進位大將軍，領司徒，餘如故。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, Grand Minister, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and Governor of Yang Province, Prince of Pengcheng Liu Yikang, was advanced to Grand General, retaining the post of Grand Minister; the rest remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, Grand Minister Liu Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng and Governor of Yang Province, was advanced to Grand General while retaining the post of Grand Minister; all else remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭進位司空，刺史如故。

translations.literal: General Who Conquers the North, with an office equal to the Three Excellencies, and Governor of Southern Yan Province, Prince of Jiangxia Liu Yigong, was advanced to Minister of Works; his governorship remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Conquers the North Liu Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was advanced to Minister of Works; his governorship remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 特進、左光祿大夫王敬弘開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Special Grand Master and Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Wang Jinghong was granted an office equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: Special Grand Master Wang Jinghong was granted an office equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，復分荊州置湘州。

translations.literal: On the day gusi, Jing Province was again divided and Xiang Province established.
translations.idiomatic: On gusi, Jing Province was again divided to establish Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，以南徐州刺史衡陽王義季為安西將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jihai of the second month, Governor of Southern Xu Province Prince of Hengyang Liu Yiji was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai in the second month, Prince of Hengyang Liu Yiji, Governor of Southern Xu Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 丁未，以始興王濬為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day dingwei, Prince of Shixing Liu Jun was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, Prince of Shixing Liu Jun was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，割梁州之巴西梓潼南宕渠南漢中、南秦州之南安懷寧凡六郡，[20]屬益州。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, the six commanderies of Baxi, Zitong, Southern Dangqu, and Southern Hanzhong of Liang Province and Nan'an and Huaining of Southern Qin Province were severed [20] and assigned to Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, the six commanderies of Baxi, Zitong, Southern Dangqu, and Southern Hanzhong from Liang Province and Nan'an and Huaining from Southern Qin Province were severed [20] and assigned to Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 分長沙江夏郡立巴陵郡，屬湘州。

translations.literal: From the commanderies of Changsha and Jiangxia, Baling Commandery was established and assigned to Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: Baling Commandery was established from Changsha and Jiangxia commanderies and assigned to Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁巳，以鎮南將軍、江州刺史南譙王義宣為征北將軍、南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day dingsi, General Who Guards the South and Governor of Jiang Province Prince of Nanqiao Liu Yixuan was appointed General Who Conquers the North and Governor of Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingsi, General Who Guards the South Liu Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao and Governor of Jiang Province, was appointed General Who Conquers the North and Governor of Southern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 平西將軍臨川王義慶為衞將軍、江州刺史。

translations.literal: General Who Pacifies the West Prince of Linchuan Liu Yiqing was appointed Defender General and Governor of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the West Liu Yiqing, Prince of Linchuan, was appointed Defender General and Governor of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，隴西吐谷渾慕容延改封河南王。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou of the sixth month, Murong Yan of Tuyuhun in Longxi was re-enfeoffed as King of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the sixth month, Murong Yan of Tuyuhun in Longxi was re-enfeoffed as King of Henan.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以吐谷渾拾寅為平西將軍，吐谷渾繁暱為撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Shibin of Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Pacifies the West, and Fan Ni of Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Shibin of Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Pacifies the West, and Fan Ni of Tuyuhun General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: 秋八月庚子，立第四皇子鑠為南平王。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of autumn, on the day gengzi, the fourth prince, Shuo, was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of autumn, on gengzi, the fourth prince Shuo was enfeoffed as Prince of Nanping.

sentences.zh: 閏月乙未，鎮軍將軍、豫州刺史長沙王義欣薨。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, on the day yiwei, General Who Guards the Army and Governor of Yu Province, Prince of Changsha Liu Yixin, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on yiwei, General Who Guards the Army Liu Yixin, Prince of Changsha and Governor of Yu Province, died.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，復分豫州之淮南為南豫州。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, Huainan of Yu Province was again severed and Southern Yu Province established.
translations.idiomatic: On wuxu, Huainan was again severed from Yu Province to establish Southern Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以左衞將軍劉遵考為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, General of the Left Guard Liu Zunkao was appointed Governor of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, General of the Left Guard Liu Zunkao was appointed Governor of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以湘州刺史始興王濬為南豫州刺史，武陵王駿為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wushen, Governor of Xiang Province Prince of Shixing Liu Jun was appointed Governor of Southern Yu Province, and Prince of Wuling Liu Jun was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Prince of Shixing Liu Jun was appointed Governor of Southern Yu Province, and Prince of Wuling Liu Jun Governor of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月乙亥，皇太子冠，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on the day yihai, the crown prince underwent the capping ceremony, and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on yihai, the crown prince came of age and a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 是歲，武都王、河南王、林邑國、高麗國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In this year, the King of Wudu, the King of Henan, Linyi, and Goryeo all sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the King of Wudu, the King of Henan, Linyi, and Goryeo all sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十七年夏四月戊午朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer of the seventeenth year, on the first day wuwu of the month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer in the seventeenth year, on the new moon wuwu, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 五月癸巳，領軍將軍劉湛母憂去職。

translations.literal: On the day guisi of the fifth month, Commander of the Army Liu Zhan left his post due to mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the fifth month, Commander of the Army Liu Zhan left his post to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬寅，以征虜諮議參軍杜驥為青州刺史。
