translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day renyin, Campaigning-Captives Advisory Officer Du Ji was appointed Governor of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renyin, Campaigning-Captives Advisory Officer Du Ji was appointed Governor of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 壬子，皇后袁氏崩。

translations.literal: On the day renzi, Empress Yuan née Yuan died.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Empress Yuan née Yuan died.

sentences.zh: 八月，徐、兗、青、冀四州大水，己未，遣使檢行賑卹。

translations.literal: In the eighth month, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces suffered great floods; on the day jiwei, envoys were dispatched to inspect and provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month, Xu, Yan, Qing, and Ji provinces suffered great floods; on jiwei, envoys were dispatched to inspect the damage and provide relief.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，葬元皇后於長寧陵。

translations.literal: On the day renzi in the ninth month, the former empress was buried at Changning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi in the ninth month, the former empress was buried at Changning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊午，前丹陽尹劉湛有罪，及同黨伏誅。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day wuwu, former Intendant of Danyang Liu Zhan was found guilty, and he and his co-conspirators were executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuwu, former Intendant of Danyang Liu Zhan was found guilty, and he and his co-conspirators were executed.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下，文武賜爵一級。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of nobility.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were advanced one rank of nobility.

sentences.zh: 以大將軍、領司徒、錄尚書、揚州刺史彭城王義康為江州刺史，大將軍如故。

translations.literal: Grand General, Grand Minister, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and Governor of Yang Province Prince of Pengcheng Liu Yikang was appointed Governor of Jiang Province, retaining his rank as Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: Grand General Liu Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng, Grand Minister, Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and Governor of Yang Province, was appointed Governor of Jiang Province, retaining his rank as Grand General.

sentences.zh: 以司空、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為司徒、錄尚書事。

translations.literal: Minister of Works and Governor of Southern Yan Province Prince of Jiangxia Liu Yigong was appointed Grand Minister and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Works Liu Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed Grand Minister and Recorder of Affairs of the Masters.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，衞將軍臨川王義慶以本號為南兗州刺史，尚書僕射、護軍將軍殷景仁為揚州刺史，僕射如故。

translations.literal: On the day wuyin, Guard General Prince of Linchuan Liu Yiqing retained his title and was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province; Vice Director of the Secretariat and Protector of the Army Yin Jingren was appointed Governor of Yang Province, retaining his post as Vice Director.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Guard General Liu Yiqing, Prince of Linchuan, retained his title and was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province; Vice Director of the Secretariat Yin Jingren was appointed Governor of Yang Province, retaining his post as Vice Director.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，以尚書劉義融為領軍將軍，祕書監徐湛之為中護軍。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day bingxu, Director of the Masters Liu Yirong was appointed Commander of the Army, and Director of the Secretariat Xu Tanzhi was appointed Central Protector of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingxu, Director of the Masters Liu Yirong was appointed Commander of the Army, and Director of the Secretariat Xu Tanzhi Central Protector of the Army.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔曰：「前所給揚、南徐二州百姓田糧種子，兗、兩豫、青、徐諸州比年所寬租穀應督入者，悉除半。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, an edict said: "The grain and seed previously granted to the people of Yang and Southern Xu provinces, and the rent grain that in recent years was remitted in Yan, both Yu, Qing, and Xu provinces and should be collected under supervision — all of these shall be reduced by half.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, an edict said: "The grain and seed previously granted to the people of Yang and Southern Xu provinces, and the rent grain remitted in recent years in Yan, both Yu, Qing, and Xu provinces that should be collected under supervision — all of these shall be reduced by half.

sentences.zh: 今年有不收處，[21]都原之。

translations.literal: Where there have been crop failures this year, [21] all such obligations shall be remitted entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Where there have been crop failures this year, [21] all such obligations shall be remitted in full.

sentences.zh: 凡諸逋債，優量申減。

translations.literal: All outstanding debts shall be assessed leniently and reduced.
translations.idiomatic: All outstanding debts shall be assessed leniently and reduced.

sentences.zh: 又州郡估稅，所在市調，多有煩刻。

translations.literal: Moreover, in the market levies and valuation taxes of the provinces and commanderies, many places impose onerous exactions.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, in the market levies and valuation taxes of the provinces and commanderies, many places impose onerous exactions.

sentences.zh: 山澤之利，猶或禁斷；

translations.literal: The benefits of mountains and marshes are still in some cases prohibited and blocked;
translations.idiomatic: The benefits of mountains and marshes are still in some cases prohibited and blocked;

sentences.zh: 役召之品，遂及稚弱。

translations.literal: Categories of corvée summons extend even to the very young and weak.
translations.idiomatic: Categories of corvée summons extend even to the very young and weak.

sentences.zh: 諸如此比，傷治害民。

translations.literal: Matters such as these harm governance and injure the people.
translations.idiomatic: Matters such as these harm governance and injure the people.

sentences.zh: 自今咸依法令，務盡優允。

translations.literal: From now on all shall comply with the statutes and ordinances, striving to extend full leniency and accommodation.
translations.idiomatic: From now on all shall comply with the statutes and ordinances, striving to extend full leniency and accommodation.

sentences.zh: 如有不便，即依事別言，不得苟趣一時，以乖隱卹之旨。

translations.literal: Where there are inconveniences, report them separately according to the circumstances; do not hastily pursue short-term gains to the detriment of the intent to relieve and show compassion.
translations.idiomatic: Where there are inconveniences, report them separately according to the circumstances; do not hastily pursue short-term gains to the detriment of the intent to relieve and show compassion.

sentences.zh: 主者明加宣下，稱朕意焉。

translations.literal: Those in charge shall clearly proclaim and disseminate this, giving voice to My intent."
translations.idiomatic: Those in charge shall clearly proclaim and disseminate this, giving voice to My intent."

sentences.zh: 」癸丑，尚書僕射、揚州刺史殷景仁卒。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, Vice Director of the Secretariat and Governor of Yang Province Yin Jingren died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Vice Director of the Secretariat Yin Jingren, Governor of Yang Province, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: On the day guihai in the twelfth month, Special Grand Master Wang Qiu was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the twelfth month, Special Grand Master Wang Qiu was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: [22]戊辰，以南豫州刺史始興王濬為揚州刺史，湘州刺史武陵王駿為南豫州刺史，南平王鑠為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: [22] On the day wuchen, Governor of Southern Yu Province Prince of Shixing Liu Jun was appointed Governor of Yang Province, Governor of Xiang Province Prince of Wuling Liu Jun was appointed Governor of Southern Yu Province, and Prince of Nanping Liu Shuo was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: [22] On wuchen, Prince of Shixing Liu Jun was appointed Governor of Yang Province, Prince of Wuling Liu Jun Governor of Southern Yu Province, and Prince of Nanping Liu Shuo Governor of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 是歲，武都王、河南王、百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In this year, the King of Wudu, the King of Henan, and the state of Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the King of Wudu, the King of Henan, and the state of Baekje sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十八年春二月乙卯，以豫章太守庾登之為江州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month of spring of the eighteenth year, on the day yimao, Governor of Yuzhang Yu Dengzhi was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of spring in the eighteenth year, on yimao, Governor of Yuzhang Yu Dengzhi was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬午，[23]衞將軍南兗州刺史臨川王義慶、征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣並開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on the day renwu, [23] Guard General and Governor of Southern Yan Province Prince of Linchuan Liu Yiqing and Campaigning-North General and Governor of Southern Xu Province Prince of Nanqiao Liu Yixuan were both granted offices equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on renwu, [23] Guard General Liu Yiqing, Prince of Linchuan and Governor of Southern Yan Province, and Campaigning-North General Liu Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao and Governor of Southern Xu Province, were both granted offices equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，於交州置宋熙郡。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, the commandery of Songxi was established in Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, the commandery of Songxi was established in Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 是月，沔水泛溢。

translations.literal: In that month, the Han River overflowed its banks.
translations.idiomatic: That month, the Han River overflowed its banks.

sentences.zh: 六月戊辰，遣使巡行賑贍。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen of the sixth month, envoys were dispatched to tour the region and provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the sixth month, envoys were dispatched to tour the region and provide relief.

sentences.zh: 辛未，領軍將軍劉義融卒。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Commander of the Army Liu Yirong died.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Commander of the Army Liu Yirong died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月戊戌，以徐、兗二州刺史趙伯符為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day wuxu, Governor of Xu and Yan provinces Zhao Bofu was appointed Commander of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on wuxu, Governor of Xu and Yan provinces Zhao Bofu was appointed Commander of the Army.

sentences.zh: 冬十月辛亥，以巴東、建平二郡太守臧質為徐、兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day xinhai, Governor of Badong and Jianping commanderies Zang Zhi was appointed Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinhai, Governor of Badong and Jianping commanderies Zang Zhi was appointed Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，省南徐州之南燕、濮陽、南廣平郡。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, the commanderies of Nanyan, Puyang, and Nanguangping in Southern Xu Province were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, the commanderies of Nanyan, Puyang, and Nanguangping in Southern Xu Province were abolished.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，尚書僕射王球卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day wuzi, Vice Director of the Secretariat Wang Qiu died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on wuzi, Vice Director of the Secretariat Wang Qiu died.

sentences.zh: [24]己亥，以丹陽尹孟顗為尚書僕射。

translations.literal: [24] On the day jihai, Intendant of Danyang Meng Yi was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: [24] On jihai, Intendant of Danyang Meng Yi was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 氐楊難當又寇漢川。

translations.literal: The Di chieftain Yang Nandang again raided the Han River region.
translations.idiomatic: The Di chieftain Yang Nandang again raided the Han River region.

sentences.zh: 十二月癸亥，遣龍驤將軍裴方明與梁、秦二州刺史劉真道討之。

translations.literal: On the day guihai in the twelfth month, General of the Dragon Cavalry Pei Fangming was dispatched with Governor of Liang and Qin provinces Liu Zhendao to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the twelfth month, General of the Dragon Cavalry Pei Fangming was dispatched with Governor of Liang and Qin provinces Liu Zhendao to attack him.

sentences.zh: 是月，[25]晉寧太守爨松子反叛，寧州刺史徐循討平之。

translations.literal: In that month, [25] Governor of Jinning Cuan Songzi rebelled; Governor of Ning Province Xu Xun suppressed and pacified him.
translations.idiomatic: That month, [25] Governor of Jinning Cuan Songzi rebelled; Governor of Ning Province Xu Xun suppressed and pacified him.

sentences.zh: 是歲，肅特國、高麗國、蘇靡黎國、林邑國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In this year, the states of Sute, Goryeo, Sumili, and Linyi all sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the states of Sute, Goryeo, Sumili, and Linyi all sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十九年正月乙巳，詔曰：「夫所因者本，聖哲之遠教；

translations.literal: In the first month of the nineteenth year, on the day yisi, an edict said: "That upon which one relies is the root — the distant teaching of the sage and wise;
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the nineteenth year, on yisi, an edict said: "That upon which one relies is the root — the distant teaching of the sage and wise;

sentences.zh: 本立化成，斆學之為貴。

translations.literal: when the root is established, transformation and cultivation follow; reverence for learning is what is prized.
translations.idiomatic: when the root is established, transformation and cultivation follow; reverence for learning is what is prized.

sentences.zh: 故詔以三德，崇以四術，用能納諸義方，致之軌度。

translations.literal: Therefore the injunction is given through the three virtues, and esteem is granted through the four arts, thereby enabling one to bring all into the paths of righteousness and lead them to proper measure.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore the injunction is given through the three virtues, and esteem is granted through the four arts, thereby enabling one to bring all into the paths of righteousness and lead them to proper measure.

sentences.zh: 盛王聖世，[26]咸必由之。

translations.literal: In an age of flourishing kings and sage rulers, [26] all must tread this path.
translations.idiomatic: In an age of flourishing kings and sage rulers, [26] all must tread this path.

sentences.zh: 永初受命，憲章弘遠，將陶鈞庶品，混一殊風，有詔典司，大啟庠序，而頻遘屯夷，未及修建。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Yongchu reign, statutes and regulations were broad and far-reaching; we sought to mold the myriad classes and unify diverse customs. An edict was issued for the responsible offices to greatly open schools — yet we repeatedly encountered adversity and had not yet completed construction.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yongchu reign, statutes and regulations were broad and far-reaching; we sought to mold the myriad classes and unify diverse customs. An edict was issued for the responsible offices to greatly open schools — yet we repeatedly encountered adversity and had not yet completed construction.

sentences.zh: 永瞻前猷，思敷鴻烈。

translations.literal: Forever gazing upon the former design, we think to spread the grand enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Forever gazing upon the former design, we think to spread the grand enterprise.

sentences.zh: 今方隅乂寧，戎夏慕嚮，廣訓冑子，實維時務。

translations.literal: Now the four quarters are at peace, barbarians and Chinese alike look to us with admiration — broadly instructing the sons of the realm is truly the task of the age.
translations.idiomatic: Now the four quarters are at peace, barbarians and Chinese alike look to us with admiration — broadly instructing the sons of the realm is truly the task of the age.

sentences.zh: 便可式遵成規，闡揚景業。」

translations.literal: Let us therefore follow established rules and proclaim the glorious enterprise."
translations.idiomatic: Let us therefore follow established rules and proclaim the glorious enterprise."

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲戌，以久疾愈，始奉礿祠，[27]大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jiaxu, having recovered from long illness, the Emperor for the first time performed the yue sacrifice; [27] a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiaxu, having recovered from long illness, the Emperor for the first time performed the yue sacrifice; [27] a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 五月庚寅，梁秦二州刺史劉真道、龍驤將軍裴方明破氐楊難當，仇池平。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin in the fifth month, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces Liu Zhendao and General of the Dragon Cavalry Pei Fangming defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nandang, and Chouchi was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin in the fifth month, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces Liu Zhendao and General of the Dragon Cavalry Pei Fangming defeated the Di chieftain Yang Nandang, and Chouchi was pacified.

sentences.zh: 閏月，京邑雨水；

translations.literal: In the intercalary month, the capital region suffered heavy rain;
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, the capital region suffered heavy rain;

sentences.zh: 丁巳，遣使巡行賑卹。

translations.literal: On the day dingsi, envoys were dispatched to tour the region and provide relief.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, envoys were dispatched to tour the region and provide relief.

sentences.zh: 六月壬午，以大沮渠無諱為征西大將軍、涼州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renwu of the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui was appointed Campaigning-West Grand General and Governor of Liang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu in the sixth month, Juqu Wuhui was appointed Campaigning-West Grand General and Governor of Liang Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，以梁、秦二州刺史劉真道為雍州刺史，龍驤將軍裴方明為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces Liu Zhendao was appointed Governor of Yong Province, and General of the Dragon Cavalry Pei Fangming was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, Governor of Liang and Qin provinces Liu Zhendao was appointed Governor of Yong Province, and General of the Dragon Cavalry Pei Fangming Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 甲戌晦，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, the last day of the month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the last day of the month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 冬十月甲申，芮芮國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jiashen, the state of Rouran sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jiashen, the state of Rouran sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 己亥，以晉寧太守周萬歲為寧州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jihai, Governor of Jinning Zhou Wansui was appointed Governor of Ning Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jihai, Governor of Jinning Zhou Wansui was appointed Governor of Ning Province.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙申，詔曰：「冑子始集，學業方興。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen in the twelfth month, an edict said: "The sons of the realm are now gathered, and their studies are just flourishing.
translations.idiomatic: On bingshen in the twelfth month, an edict said: "The sons of the realm are now gathered, and their studies are just flourishing.

sentences.zh: 自微言泯絕，逝將千祀，感事思人，意有慨然。

translations.literal: Since the subtle teachings were extinguished, nearly a thousand years have passed; moved by the matter, we think of those men, and our feeling is one of deep emotion.
translations.idiomatic: Since the subtle teachings were extinguished, nearly a thousand years have passed; moved by the matter, we think of those men, and our feeling is one of deep emotion.

sentences.zh: 奉聖之胤，可速議繼襲。

translations.literal: The descendants of the Sage may speedily be considered for succession.
translations.idiomatic: The descendants of the Sage may speedily be considered for succession.

sentences.zh: 於先廟地，特為營造，依舊給祠置令，四時饗祀。

translations.literal: On the site of the former temple, a special establishment shall be built, and sacrificial officers shall be appointed as of old, with offerings at the four seasons.
translations.idiomatic: On the site of the former temple, a special establishment shall be built, and sacrificial officers shall be appointed as of old, with offerings at the four seasons.

sentences.zh: 闕里往經寇亂，黌校殘毀，并下魯郡修復學舍，採召生徒。

translations.literal: The village of Queli had in the past suffered bandit raids, and the school buildings were ruined; orders were also sent down to Lu Commandery to restore the school buildings and recruit students.
translations.idiomatic: The village of Queli had in the past suffered bandit raids, and the school buildings were ruined; orders were also sent down to Lu Commandery to restore the school buildings and recruit students.

sentences.zh: 昔之賢哲及一介之善，猶或衞其丘壟，禁其芻牧，況尼父德表生民，功被百代，而墳塋荒蕪，荊棘弗翦。

translations.literal: Former sages and wise men, and even men of a single virtue, still had their mounds guarded and grazing forbidden upon them — how much more so Confucius, whose virtue stands as a model for the living and whose merit extends through a hundred generations, yet whose tomb and precinct lie waste and overgrown with thorns and brambles.
translations.idiomatic: Former sages and wise men, and even men of a single virtue, still had their mounds guarded and grazing forbidden upon them — how much more so Confucius, whose virtue stands as a model for the living and whose merit extends through a hundred generations, yet whose tomb and precinct lie waste and overgrown with thorns and brambles.

sentences.zh: 可蠲墓側數戶，以掌洒掃。

translations.literal: Several households beside the tomb may be exempted from tax and corvée to maintain sweeping and cleaning."
translations.idiomatic: Several households beside the tomb may be exempted from tax and corvée to maintain sweeping and cleaning."

sentences.zh: 」魯郡上民孔景等五戶居近孔子墓側，蠲其課役，供給洒掃，并種松栢六百株。

translations.literal: Five households of the leading families of Lu Commandery, including Kong Jing, who lived near Confucius's tomb, were exempted from tax and corvée and charged with sweeping and cleaning; six hundred pine and cypress trees were also planted.
translations.idiomatic: Five households of the leading families of Lu Commandery, including Kong Jing, who lived near Confucius's tomb, were exempted from tax and corvée and charged with sweeping and cleaning; six hundred pine and cypress trees were also planted.

sentences.zh: 是歲，婆皇國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In this year, the state of Bharu sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the state of Bharu sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 二十年春正月，於臺城東西開萬春、千秋二門。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twentieth year, the Wan Spring and Thousand Autumns gates were opened on the east and west of the palace city.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the twentieth year, the Wan Spring and Thousand Autumns gates were opened on the east and west of the palace city.

sentences.zh: 二月甲戌，江州刺史庾登之為中護軍。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu in the second month, Governor of Jiang Province Yu Dengzhi was appointed Central Protector of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu in the second month, Governor of Jiang Province Yu Dengzhi was appointed Central Protector of the Army.

sentences.zh: 庚申，[28]以廬陵王紹為江州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, [28] Prince of Luling Liu Shao was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, [28] Prince of Luling Liu Shao was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 仇池為索虜所沒。

translations.literal: Chouchi was overrun by the Northern Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Chouchi was overrun by the Northern Wei.

sentences.zh: 甲申，車駕於白下閱武。

translations.literal: On the day jiashen, the imperial carriage reviewed troops at Baixia.
translations.idiomatic: On jiashen, the Emperor reviewed troops at Baixia.

sentences.zh: 三月辛亥，安西將軍、荊州刺史衡陽王義季進號征西大將軍。

translations.literal: On the day xinhai in the third month, General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Jing Province Prince of Hengyang Liu Yiji was advanced in rank to Campaigning-West Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai in the third month, General Who Pacifies the West Liu Yiji, Prince of Hengyang and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced to Campaigning-West Grand General.

sentences.zh: 以巴西、梓潼二郡太守申坦為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: Governor of Bazhong and Zitong commanderies Shen Tan was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Bazhong and Zitong commanderies Shen Tan was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 夏四月甲午，立第六皇子誕為廣陵王。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day jiawu, the sixth prince, Dan, was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on jiawu, the sixth prince Dan was enfeoffed as Prince of Guangling.

sentences.zh: 五月癸丑，中護軍庾登之卒。

translations.literal: On the day guichou in the fifth month, Central Protector of the Army Yu Dengzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the fifth month, Central Protector of the Army Yu Dengzhi died.

sentences.zh: 秋七月癸丑，以楊文德為征西將軍、北秦州刺史，封武都王。

translations.literal: On the day guichou in the seventh month of autumn, Yang Wende was appointed Campaigning-West General and Governor of Northern Qin Province and enfeoffed as King of Wudu.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou in the seventh month of autumn, Yang Wende was appointed Campaigning-West General and Governor of Northern Qin Province and enfeoffed as King of Wudu.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以南蠻校尉蕭思話為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Colonel of the Southern Barbarians Xiao Sihua was appointed Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Colonel of the Southern Barbarians Xiao Sihua was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 甲子，前雍州刺史劉真道、梁南秦二州刺史裴方明有罪，下獄死。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, former Governor of Yong Province Liu Zhendao and Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces Pei Fangming were found guilty, imprisoned, and put to death.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, former Governor of Yong Province Liu Zhendao and Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces Pei Fangming were found guilty, imprisoned, and put to death.

sentences.zh: 八月癸未，以廷尉陶愍祖為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei in the eighth month, Director of the Court of Judicial Review Tao Minzu was appointed Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei in the eighth month, Director of the Court of Judicial Review Tao Minzu was appointed Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十二月庚午，以始興內史檀和之為交州刺史。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of winter, on the day gengwu, Internal Administrator of Shixing Tan Hezhi was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of winter, on gengwu, Internal Administrator of Shixing Tan Hezhi was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 壬午，詔曰：「國以民為本，民以食為天。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, an edict said: "The state takes the people as its foundation, and the people take food as their heaven.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, an edict said: "The state takes the people as its foundation, and the people take food as their heaven.

sentences.zh: 故一夫輟稼，饑者必及。

translations.literal: Therefore if a single man ceases to farm, hunger must reach others.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore if a single man ceases to farm, hunger must reach others.

sentences.zh: 倉廩既實，禮節以興。

translations.literal: When the granaries are full, ritual and propriety arise.
translations.idiomatic: When the granaries are full, ritual and propriety arise.

sentences.zh: 自頃在所貧罄，家無宿積。

translations.literal: Of late everywhere has been destitute, and no household keeps stores overnight.
translations.idiomatic: Of late everywhere has been destitute, and no household keeps stores overnight.

sentences.zh: 賦役暫偏，則人懷愁墊；

translations.literal: When taxes and corvée fall unevenly, the people are filled with distress;
translations.idiomatic: When taxes and corvée fall unevenly, the people are filled with distress;

sentences.zh: 歲或不稔，而病乏比室。

translations.literal: When a year fails to yield a harvest, want and exhaustion afflict every household.
translations.idiomatic: When a year fails to yield a harvest, want and exhaustion afflict every household.

sentences.zh: 誠由政德弗孚，以臻斯弊；

translations.literal: This is truly because governmental virtue has not won trust, leading to such abuses;
translations.idiomatic: This is truly because governmental virtue has not won trust, leading to such abuses;

sentences.zh: 抑亦耕桑未廣，地利多遺。

translations.literal: yet it is also because farming and sericulture have not been widely extended, and much of the land's benefit remains untapped.
translations.idiomatic: yet it is also because farming and sericulture have not been widely extended, and much of the land's benefit remains untapped.

sentences.zh: 宰守微化導之方，萌庶忘勤分之義。

translations.literal: District magistrates have slighted the methods of transforming and guiding the people, and the common folk have forgotten the duty of diligent self-support.
translations.idiomatic: District magistrates have slighted the methods of transforming and guiding the people, and the common folk have forgotten the duty of diligent self-support.

sentences.zh: 永言弘濟，明發載懷。

translations.literal: Ever speaking of broad relief, we awaken at dawn with this fixed in our hearts.
translations.idiomatic: Ever speaking of broad relief, we awaken at dawn with this fixed in our hearts.

sentences.zh: 雖制令亟下，終莫懲勸，而坐望滋殖，庸可致乎。

translations.literal: Although regulations and orders have been issued repeatedly, in the end none have corrected or encouraged; yet to sit and expect increase and growth — how can that be achieved?
translations.idiomatic: Although regulations and orders have been issued repeatedly, in the end none have corrected or encouraged; yet to sit and expect increase and growth — how can that be achieved?

sentences.zh: 有司其班宣舊條，務盡敦課。

translations.literal: The responsible offices shall proclaim the old statutes and strive to enforce cultivation fully.
translations.idiomatic: The responsible offices shall proclaim the old statutes and strive to enforce cultivation fully.

sentences.zh: 遊食之徒，咸令附業，考覈勤惰，行其誅賞，觀察能殿，嚴加黜陟。

translations.literal: All who wander and idly eat shall be ordered to attach themselves to occupations; diligence and sloth shall be examined and verified, and rewards and punishments applied; ability and failure shall be observed, and demotion and promotion strictly enforced.
translations.idiomatic: All who wander and idly eat shall be ordered to attach themselves to occupations; diligence and sloth shall be examined and verified, and rewards and punishments applied; ability and failure shall be observed, and demotion and promotion strictly enforced.

sentences.zh: 古者躬耕帝籍，敬供粢盛，仰瞻前王，思遵令典。

translations.literal: In antiquity the ruler personally plowed the imperial field and reverently supplied the sacrificial grain; looking up to the former kings, we think to follow their established canon.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity the ruler personally plowed the imperial field and reverently supplied the sacrificial grain; looking up to the former kings, we think to follow their established canon.

sentences.zh: 便可量處千畝，考卜元辰。

translations.literal: Let a thousand mu be measured out and the auspicious day divined.
translations.idiomatic: Let a thousand mu be measured out and the auspicious day divined.

sentences.zh: 朕當親率百辟，致禮郊甸，庶幾誠素，將被斯民。」

translations.literal: We shall personally lead the hundred officials to perform the rites in the suburban fields, hoping that sincerity and plainness may reach the people."
translations.idiomatic: We shall personally lead the hundred officials to perform the rites in the suburban fields, hoping that sincerity and plainness may reach the people."

sentences.zh: 是歲，河西國、高麗國、百濟國、倭國並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In this year, the state of Hexi, Goryeo, the state of Baekje, and Wa all sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the state of Hexi, Goryeo, the state of Baekje, and Wa all sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 是歲，諸州郡水旱傷稼，民大饑。

translations.literal: In this year, the provinces and commanderies suffered flood and drought that damaged the crops, and the people suffered great famine.
translations.idiomatic: That year, the provinces and commanderies suffered flood and drought that damaged the crops, and the people suffered great famine.

sentences.zh: 遣使開倉賑卹，給賜糧種。

translations.literal: Envoys were dispatched to open the granaries for relief, and grain and seed were granted.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to open the granaries for relief, and grain and seed were granted.

sentences.zh: 二十一年春正月己亥，南徐、南豫州、揚州之浙江西，[29]並禁酒。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-first year, on the day jihai, the region west of the Zhe River in Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and Yang provinces [29] was all placed under an alcohol prohibition.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the twenty-first year, on jihai, the region west of the Zhe River in Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and Yang provinces [29] was placed under an alcohol prohibition.

sentences.zh: 大赦天下。

translations.literal: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 諸逋債在十九年以前，一切原除。

translations.literal: All overdue debts dating from before the nineteenth year were entirely remitted.
translations.idiomatic: All outstanding debts incurred before the nineteenth year were completely forgiven.

sentences.zh: 去歲失收者，疇量申減。

translations.literal: For places that failed to harvest last year, remissions were petitioned after careful assessment.
translations.idiomatic: Where the harvest had failed the previous year, reductions were petitioned after careful assessment.

sentences.zh: 尤弊之處，遣使就郡縣隨宜賑卹。

translations.literal: In places of particular hardship, envoys were dispatched to the commanderies and counties to grant relief as circumstances required.
translations.idiomatic: In the hardest-hit areas, envoys were sent to the commanderies and counties to provide relief as local conditions warranted.

sentences.zh: 凡欲附農，而種糧匱乏者，並加給貸。

translations.literal: All who wished to return to farming but lacked seed grain were additionally given loans.
translations.idiomatic: All who wished to settle on the land but lacked seed grain were given additional loans.

sentences.zh: 營千畝諸統司役人，賜布各有差。

translations.literal: Corvee laborers in the thousand-mu cultivation units under the various stewardship offices were granted cloth in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Corvee laborers assigned to the thousand-mu cultivation units received cloth grants apportioned by rank.

sentences.zh: 戊午，衞將軍臨川王義慶薨。

translations.literal: On the day wuwu, Guard General Liu Yiqing, Prince of Linchuan, died.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, Guard General Liu Yiqing, Prince of Linchuan, died.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，以太子詹事劉義宗為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day xinyou, Crown Prince Household Administrator Liu Yizong was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou, Crown Prince Household Administrator Liu Yizong was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 二月庚午，以領軍將軍趙伯符為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengwu, Commander of the Army Zhao Bofu was appointed Governor of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengwu, Commander of the Army Zhao Bofu was appointed Governor of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 己丑，司徒、錄尚書事江夏王義恭進位太尉，領司徒。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Minister over the Masses and Director of the Imperial Secretariat Liu Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia, was advanced to Grand Marshal and retained the post of Minister over the Masses.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Minister over the Masses Liu Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia and Director of the Imperial Secretariat, was advanced to Grand Marshal while retaining the Ministry over the Masses.

sentences.zh: 庚寅，以右衞將軍沈演之為中領軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengyin, General of the Right Guard Shen Yanzhi was appointed Central Commander of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengyin, General of the Right Guard Shen Yanzhi was appointed Central Commander of the Army.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，立第七皇子宏為建平王。

translations.literal: On the day xinmao, the seventh imperial son, Hong, was enfeoffed as Prince of Jianping.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the seventh imperial son Hong was enfeoffed as Prince of Jianping.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以廣陵王誕為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiawu, Prince Dan of Guangling was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, Prince Dan of Guangling was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 夏四月，晉陵延陵民徐耕以米千斛助卹饑民。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, Xu Geng of Yanling in Jinling commandery contributed a thousand hu of rice to aid famine victims.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, Xu Geng of Yanling in Jinling commandery donated a thousand hu of rice to relieve the famine-stricken.

sentences.zh: 五月壬戌，以尚書何尚之為中護軍，諮議參軍劉道錫為廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renxu of the fifth month, Minister He Shangzhi was appointed Central Protector of the Army, and Consultative Aide Liu Daoxi was appointed Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the fifth month, Minister He Shangzhi was appointed Central Protector of the Army, and Consultative Aide Liu Daoxi Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 六月，連雨水。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, continuous rain fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, rain fell without cease.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，詔曰：「霖雨彌日，水潦為患，百姓積儉，易致乏匱。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai, an edict said: "The steady rain has continued for days, flooding has become a calamity, and the people, long living in want, are easily driven to destitution."
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, an edict said: "Rain has fallen day after day, flooding has become a disaster, and the people, long accustomed to hardship, are easily brought to destitution."

sentences.zh: 二縣官長及營署部司，各隨統檢實，給其柴米，必使周悉。」

translations.literal: The magistrates of the two counties and the supervisory offices of the camps were each to inspect and verify according to their jurisdiction and supply fuel and grain, ensuring that provision was thorough and complete."
translations.idiomatic: The magistrates of the two counties and the camp supervisory offices were each to inspect their jurisdictions, verify needs, and supply firewood and grain until every household was fully provided for."

sentences.zh: 秋七月丁酉，揚州刺史始興王濬加中軍將軍，南豫州刺史武陵王駿加撫軍將軍。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day dingyou, Prince Jun of Shixing, Governor of Yang Province, was additionally appointed Central-Army General, and Prince Jun of Wuling, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on dingyou, Prince Jun of Shixing, Governor of Yang Province, was additionally appointed Central-Army General, and Prince Jun of Wuling, Governor of Southern Yu Province, General Who Pacifies the Army.

sentences.zh: [30]乙巳，詔曰：「比年穀稼傷損，淫亢成災，亦由播殖之宜，尚有未盡。

translations.literal: [30] On the day yisi, an edict said: "In recent years grain crops have been damaged, and excessive drought has become a disaster — this is also because the suitability of planting has not yet been fully observed."
translations.idiomatic: [30] On yisi, an edict said: "In recent years the harvests have suffered, and prolonged drought has brought disaster — in part because suitable planting practices have not yet been fully carried out."

sentences.zh: 南徐、兗、豫及揚州浙江西屬郡，自今悉督種麥，以助闕乏。

translations.literal: In the commanderies under Southern Xu, Yan, Yu, and Yang provinces west of the Zhe River, wheat is henceforth to be supervised and planted throughout, to help make up the shortfall.
translations.idiomatic: Throughout Southern Xu, Yan, Yu, and the Yang-province commanderies west of the Zhe River, wheat cultivation is henceforth to be supervised everywhere to help offset the shortage.

sentences.zh: 速運彭城下邳郡見種，委刺史貸給。

translations.literal: Seed wheat presently grown in Pengcheng and Xiapi commanderies is to be transported quickly and entrusted to the provincial governors for loan distribution.
translations.idiomatic: Seed wheat now growing in Pengcheng and Xiapi commanderies is to be shipped at once and lent out by the provincial governors.

sentences.zh: 徐、豫土多稻田，而民間專務陸作，可符二鎮，履行舊陂，相率修立，并課墾闢，使及來年。

translations.literal: Xu and Yu provinces have much paddy land, yet the common people devoted themselves solely to dry-field cultivation; the two military prefectures were ordered to inspect and restore the old reservoirs, jointly repair them, and impose reclamation duties so that the work would be completed by the coming year.
translations.idiomatic: Xu and Yu provinces abound in paddy fields, yet the people had focused only on dry-land farming; the two military prefectures were instructed to inspect the old reservoirs, restore them in concert, and assign reclamation duties so the work would be finished by the next year.

sentences.zh: 凡諸州郡，皆令盡勤地利，勸導播殖，蠶桑麻紵，各盡其方，不得但奉行公文而已。」

translations.literal: In all provinces and commanderies, every advantage of the land is to be fully exploited, planting is to be encouraged and guided, and mulberry, hemp, and ramie are each to be cultivated according to their proper methods — they must not merely circulate official documents and leave it at that."
translations.idiomatic: Every province and commandery is to make full use of its land, encourage cultivation, and raise mulberry, hemp, and ramie each in its proper season — not merely issue documents and consider the task done."

sentences.zh: 八月戊辰，征西大將軍、荊州刺史衡陽王義季為征北大將軍、開府儀同三司、南兗州刺史，征北將軍、南徐州刺史南譙王義宣為車騎將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen of the eighth month, Grand General Who Conquers the West and Governor of Jing Province Liu Yiji, Prince of Hengyang, was appointed Grand General Who Conquers the North, with an office equal to the Three Excellencies, and Governor of Southern Yan Province; General Who Conquers the North and Governor of Southern Xu Province Liu Xuanyi, Prince of Nanqiao, was appointed General of the Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen in the eighth month, Grand General Who Conquers the West Liu Yiji, Prince of Hengyang and Governor of Jing Province, was appointed Grand General Who Conquers the North with an office equal to the Three Excellencies and Governor of Southern Yan Province; General Who Conquers the North Liu Xuanyi, Prince of Nanqiao and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was made General of the Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: [31]南兗州刺史廣陵王誕為南徐州刺史。

translations.literal: [31] Prince Dan of Guangling, Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: [31] Prince Dan of Guangling, Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 九月甲辰，以大沮渠安周為征西將軍、涼州刺史，封河西王。

translations.literal: On the day jiachen of the ninth month, Juqu Anzhou of the Great Juqu was appointed Grand General Who Conquers the West and Governor of Liang Province, and enfeoffed as Prince of Hexi.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen in the ninth month, Juqu Anzhou of the Great Juqu was appointed Grand General Who Conquers the West and Governor of Liang Province, and enfeoffed as Prince of Hexi.

sentences.zh: 冬十月己卯，以左軍將軍徐瓊為兗州刺史，大將軍參軍申恬為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day jimao, General of the Left Army Xu Qiong was appointed Governor of Yan Province, and Grand General staff officer Shen Tian was appointed Governor of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on jimao, General of the Left Army Xu Qiong was appointed Governor of Yan Province, and Grand General staff officer Shen Tian Governor of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 二十二年春正月辛卯朔，改用御史中丞何承天元嘉新曆。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-second year, on the day xinmao, the first day of the month, the Yuanjia New Calendar by Censor-in-Chief He Chengtian was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the twenty-second year, on the new moon xinmao, the Yuanjia New Calendar by Censor-in-Chief He Chengtian was put into use.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，撫軍將軍、南豫州刺史武陵王駿改為雍州刺史，湘州刺史南平王鑠為南豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Southern Yu Province Liu Jun, Prince of Wuling, was changed to Governor of Yong Province, and Prince Shao of Nanping, Governor of Xiang Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, General Who Pacifies the Army Liu Jun, Prince of Wuling and Governor of Southern Yu Province, was transferred to Governor of Yong Province, and Prince Shao of Nanping, Governor of Xiang Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 二月辛巳，以侍中王僧朗為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day xinsi, Palace Attendant Wang Senglang was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on xinsi, Palace Attendant Wang Senglang was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，立第八皇子褘為東海王，第九皇子昶為義陽王。

translations.literal: On the day jiaxu, the eighth imperial son, Hui, was enfeoffed as Prince of Donghai, and the ninth imperial son, Chang, as Prince of Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu, the eighth imperial son Hui was enfeoffed as Prince of Donghai, and the ninth imperial son Chang as Prince of Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 夏六月辛亥，以南豫州刺史南平王鑠為豫州刺史。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of summer, on the day xinhai, Prince Shao of Nanping, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was appointed Governor of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of summer, on xinhai, Prince Shao of Nanping, Governor of Southern Yu Province, was appointed Governor of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月己未，以尚書僕射孟顗為尚書左僕射，中護軍何尚之為尚書右僕射。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day jiwei, Vice Director of the Secretariat Meng Yi was appointed Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, and Central Protector of the Army He Shangzhi was appointed Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on jiwei, Vice Director of the Secretariat Meng Yi was appointed Left Vice Director, and Central Protector of the Army He Shangzhi Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 雍州刺史武陵王駿討緣沔蠻，移一萬四千餘口於京師。

translations.literal: Governor of Yong Province Liu Jun, Prince of Wuling, campaigned against the Man tribes along the Han River and relocated more than fourteen thousand persons to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jun, Prince of Wuling and Governor of Yong Province, campaigned against the Man along the Han River and moved more than fourteen thousand people to the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，征北大將軍、南兗州刺史衡陽王義季改為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day yiyou, Grand General Who Conquers the North and Governor of Southern Yan Province Liu Yiji, Prince of Hengyang, was changed to Governor of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, Grand General Who Conquers the North Liu Yiji, Prince of Hengyang and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was transferred to Governor of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，[32]開酒禁。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei of the ninth month, [32] the prohibition on wine was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the ninth month, [32] the ban on wine was lifted.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，起湖熟廢田千頃。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, a thousand qing of abandoned fields at Hushu were brought back into cultivation.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, a thousand qing of derelict fields at Hushu were restored to cultivation.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙未，太子詹事范曄謀反，及黨與皆伏誅。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei of the twelfth month, Crown Prince Household Administrator Fan Ye plotted rebellion, and he and his accomplices were all executed.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the twelfth month, Crown Prince Household Administrator Fan Ye plotted rebellion, and he and his associates were all put to death.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，免大將軍彭城王義康為庶人。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, Grand General Liu Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng, was stripped of rank and made a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, Grand General Liu Yikang, Prince of Pengcheng, was demoted to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以前豫州刺史趙伯符為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu, former Governor of Yu Province Zhao Bofu was appointed Protector of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu, former Governor of Yu Province Zhao Bofu was appointed Protector of the Army.

sentences.zh: 二十三年春正月丁巳，以長沙內史陸徽為益州刺史。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-third year, on the day dingsi, Interior Minister of Changsha Lu Hui was appointed Governor of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the twenty-third year, on dingsi, Interior Minister of Changsha Lu Hui was appointed Governor of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 庚申，尚書左僕射孟顗去職。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Meng Yi left office.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, Left Vice Director of the Secretariat Meng Yi left office.

sentences.zh: 遷漢川流民於沔次。

translations.literal: Han River refugees were relocated to the banks of the Han.
translations.idiomatic: Refugees from Hanzhong were resettled along the Han River.

translations.literal: Annotation marker 33.
translations.idiomatic: Textual annotation marker 33.

sentences.zh: 二月癸卯，以左衞將軍劉義賓為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day guimao, General of the Left Guard Liu Yibin was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on guimao, General of the Left Guard Liu Yibin was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 三月，索虜寇兗、豫，青、冀刺史申恬破之。

translations.literal: In the third month, the Northern Wei raided Yan and Yu provinces; Governor of Qing and Ji provinces Shen Tian defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, the Northern Wei raided Yan and Yu provinces and were defeated by Shen Tian, Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 夏四月丁未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day dingwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on dingwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 六月癸未朔，日有蝕之。

translations.literal: On the first day guiwei of the sixth month, there was an eclipse of the sun.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon guiwei in the sixth month, there was a solar eclipse.

sentences.zh: 交州刺史檀和之伐林邑國，剋之。

translations.literal: Governor of Jiao Province Tan Hezhi attacked the state of Linyi and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: Governor of Jiao Province Tan Hezhi attacked Linyi and conquered it.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，以散騎常侍杜坦為青州刺史。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day xinwei, Palace Attendant for Regular Cavalry Du Tan was appointed Governor of Qing Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinwei, Palace Attendant for Regular Cavalry Du Tan was appointed Governor of Qing Province.

sentences.zh: 八月癸卯，揭陽赭賊攻建安郡，燔燒城府。

translations.literal: On the day guimao of the eighth month, outlaws from Jieyang attacked Jian'an commandery and burned the government offices.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao in the eighth month, bandits from Jieyang attacked Jian'an commandery and burned the government offices.

sentences.zh: 九月己卯，車駕幸國子學，策試諸生，答問凡五十九人。

translations.literal: On the day jimao of the ninth month, the imperial carriage visited the Imperial Academy; the students were examined by written test, and fifty-nine passed the oral questioning.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the ninth month, the Emperor visited the Imperial Academy, examined the students in written tests, and fifty-nine passed the oral examination.

sentences.zh: 冬十月戊子，詔曰：「庠序興立累載，冑子肄業有成。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day wuzi, an edict said: "The schools have been established for many years, and the sons of the nobility have completed their studies with success."
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on wuzi, an edict said: "The academies have stood for many years, and the imperial students have completed their studies with real achievement."

sentences.zh: 近親策試，覩濟濟之美，緬想洙、泗，永懷在昔。

translations.literal: In the recent examination I witnessed their splendid array, and looking back to the streams of Zhu and Si, I ever cherish the past.
translations.idiomatic: In the recent examination I beheld their splendid assembly, and thinking of the schools of Zhu and Si, I am ever mindful of the sages of old.

sentences.zh: 諸生答問，多可採覽。

translations.literal: The students' answers in questioning were largely worthy of review.
translations.idiomatic: The students' responses in the oral examination were for the most part worthy of note.

sentences.zh: 教授之官，並宜沾賚。

translations.literal: The instructors are all to share in the reward."
translations.idiomatic: The teaching officials shall all receive a share of the reward."

sentences.zh: 」賜帛各有差。

translations.literal: Cloth was granted in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: Cloth grants were distributed according to rank.

sentences.zh: 十二月丁酉，以龍驤司馬蕭景憲為交州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou of the twelfth month, Dragon Cavalry staff officer Xiao Jingxian was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the twelfth month, Dragon Cavalry staff officer Xiao Jingxian was appointed Governor of Jiao Province.

sentences.zh: 是歲，大有年。

translations.literal: In this year there was a great harvest.
translations.idiomatic: That year brought a bumper harvest.

sentences.zh: 築北堤，立玄武湖，築景陽山於華林園。

translations.literal: The northern embankment was built, Black Tortoise Lake was established, and Jingyang Hill was constructed in Hualin Garden.
translations.idiomatic: The northern dike was built, Black Tortoise Lake was created, and Jingyang Hill was raised in Hualin Garden.

sentences.zh: 二十四年春正月甲戌，大赦天下，文武賜位一等。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-fourth year, on the day jiaxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were granted one rank of advancement.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the twenty-fourth year, on jiaxu, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm, and civil and military officials were advanced one rank.

sentences.zh: 繫囚降宥，諸逋負寬減各有差。

translations.literal: Imprisoned offenders received clemence by reduction of sentence, and overdue obligations were remitted in varying degrees.
translations.idiomatic: Prisoners received reduced sentences, and overdue obligations were remitted to varying degrees.

sentences.zh: 孤老、六疾不能自存，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: Orphans and the elderly, and those suffering the six kinds of infirmity who could not support themselves, were each granted five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Orphans and the elderly, and those afflicted with the six kinds of infirmity who could not sustain themselves, each received five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 蠲建康、秣陵二縣今年田租之半。

translations.literal: Half of this year's land tax for Jiankang and Moling counties was remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Half of the year's land tax for Jiankang and Moling counties was remitted.

sentences.zh: 三月壬申，護軍將軍趙伯符遷職。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day renshen, Protector of the Army Zhao Bofu was transferred from his post.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on renshen, Protector of the Army Zhao Bofu was transferred from his post.

sentences.zh: 夏五月甲戌，青州刺史杜坦加冀州刺史。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of summer, on the day jiaxu, Governor of Qing Province Du Tan was additionally appointed Governor of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of summer, on jiaxu, Governor of Qing Province Du Tan was additionally appointed Governor of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 六月，京邑疫癘，丙戌，使郡縣及營署部司，普加履行，給以醫藥。

translations.literal: In the sixth month, an epidemic struck the capital; on the day bingxu, envoys were sent to the commanderies, counties, and camp supervisory offices to conduct inspections throughout and supply medicine.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month an epidemic struck the capital; on bingxu, envoys were dispatched to the commanderies, counties, and military camps to inspect the afflicted and distribute medicine.

sentences.zh: 是月，以貨貴，制大錢一當兩。

translations.literal: In this month, because goods were costly, large coins were mandated at a value of two.
translations.idiomatic: That month, because prices were high, large coins were decreed to pass at double value.

sentences.zh: 秋七月乙卯，以林邑所獲金銀寶物，班賚各有差。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day yimao, the gold, silver, and precious objects taken from Linyi were distributed as rewards in graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on yimao, gold, silver, and treasures captured from Linyi were distributed as rewards in graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 八月乙未，征北大將軍、徐州刺史衡陽王義季薨。

translations.literal: On the day yiwei of the eighth month, Grand General Who Conquers the North and Governor of Xu Province Liu Yiji, Prince of Hengyang, died.
translations.idiomatic: On yiwei in the eighth month, Grand General Who Conquers the North Liu Yiji, Prince of Hengyang and Governor of Xu Province, died.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以南兗州刺史劉義賓為徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, Governor of Southern Yan Province Liu Yibin was appointed Governor of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Liu Yibin, Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed Governor of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 九月己未，以中領軍沈演之為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei of the ninth month, Central Commander of the Army Shen Yanzhi was appointed Commander of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei in the ninth month, Central Commander of the Army Shen Yanzhi was appointed Commander of the Army.

sentences.zh: 辛未，以太子詹事徐湛之為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei, Crown Prince Household Administrator Xu Zhanzhi was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Crown Prince Household Administrator Xu Zhanzhi was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十月壬午，豫章胡誕世反，殺太守桓隆之，前交州刺史檀和之南還至豫章，因討平之。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day renwu, Hu Danshi of Yuzhang rebelled and killed Prefect Huan Longzhi; former Governor of Jiao Province Tan Hezhi, returning south and reaching Yuzhang, thereupon suppressed and pacified the rebellion.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on renwu, Hu Danshi of Yuzhang rebelled and killed Prefect Huan Longzhi; Tan Hezhi, former Governor of Jiao Province, encountered the uprising on his return south through Yuzhang and put it down.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，以建平王宏為中護軍。

translations.literal: On the day renchen, Prince Hong of Jianping was appointed Central Protector of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Prince Hong of Jianping was appointed Central Protector of the Army.

sentences.zh: 十一月甲寅，立第十皇子渾為汝陰王。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on the day jiayin, the tenth imperial son, Hun, was enfeoffed as Prince of Ruyin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiayin, the tenth imperial son Hun was enfeoffed as Prince of Ruyin.

sentences.zh: 二十五年春正月戊辰，詔曰：「比者冰雪經旬，薪粒貴踊，貧弊之室，多有窘罄。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-fifth year, on the day wuchen, an edict said: "Recently ice and snow have persisted for ten days, and the price of fuel and grain has soared; poor and destitute households are largely driven to utter want."
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the twenty-fifth year, on wuchen, an edict said: "Of late ice and snow have lasted ten days, and the price of firewood and grain has risen sharply; among the poor, many households have been brought to the edge of destitution."

sentences.zh: 可檢行京邑二縣及營署，賜以柴米。」

translations.literal: An inspection is to be conducted of the two capital counties and the camps, and firewood and grain are to be granted."
translations.idiomatic: The two capital counties and the military camps are to be inspected, and firewood and grain distributed."

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，詔曰：「安不忘虞，經世之所同；

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day gengyin, an edict said: "In security one must not forget danger — this is what governing the age holds in common;
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on gengyin, an edict said: "In times of peace one must not forget peril — this every age of governance holds in common;

sentences.zh: 治兵教戰，有國之恒典。

translations.literal: drilling the army and teaching warfare is the constant standard of a state.
translations.idiomatic: to drill the army and teach warfare is the standing practice of every state.

sentences.zh: 故服訓明恥，然後少長知禁。

translations.literal: Only after they are trained in discipline and know shame will young and old alike understand what is forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Only when men are trained in discipline and taught shame will young and old alike know what is forbidden.

sentences.zh: 頃戎政雖修，而號令未審。

translations.literal: Recently military affairs have indeed been put in order, yet the commands have not been made clear.
translations.idiomatic: Of late military affairs have indeed been set in order, yet the orders remain unclear.

sentences.zh: 今宣武場始成，便可剋日大習眾軍。

translations.literal: Now that the Xuanwu parade ground has just been completed, a day may at once be fixed for a great drill of all the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the Xuanwu parade ground is newly finished, a date should be set at once for a grand review of all the armies.

sentences.zh: 當因校獵，肄武講事。」

translations.literal: It shall take the form of a combined hunt, to exercise martial skill and discuss military affairs."
translations.idiomatic: The review shall take the form of a hunt, to drill the troops and rehearse military operations."

sentences.zh: 閏月己酉，大蒐于宣武場。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou of the intercalary month, a grand hunt was held at the Xuanwu parade ground.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the intercalary month, a grand hunt was held on the Xuanwu parade ground.

sentences.zh: 三月庚辰，車駕校獵。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day gengchen, the imperial carriage conducted a military hunt.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on gengchen, the Emperor conducted a military hunt.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙巳，新作閶闔、廣莫二門，改先廣莫門曰承明，開陽曰津陽。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of summer, on the day yisi, the new Changhe and Guangmo gates were built; the former Guangmo Gate was renamed Chenming, and Kaiyang was renamed Jinyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer, on yisi, the new Changhe and Guangmo gates were constructed; the old Guangmo Gate was renamed Chenming, and Kaiyang renamed Jinyang.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，以撫軍將軍、雍州刺史武陵王駿為安北將軍、徐州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day yimao, General Who Pacifies the Army and Governor of Yong Province Liu Jun, Prince of Wuling, was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao, General Who Pacifies the Army Liu Jun, Prince of Wuling and Governor of Yong Province, was appointed General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以右衞將軍蕭思話為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day guihai, General of the Right Guard Xiao Sihua was appointed Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai, General of the Right Guard Xiao Sihua was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 五月己卯，罷大錢當兩。

translations.literal: On the day jimao of the fifth month, the decree equating large coins with two was repealed.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao in the fifth month, the decree making large coins pass at double value was repealed.

sentences.zh: 六月庚戌，零陵王司馬元瑜薨。

translations.literal: On the day gengxu of the sixth month, staff officer Yuan Yu of the Prince of Lingling died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu in the sixth month, staff officer Yuan Yu of the Prince of Lingling died.

sentences.zh: 庚申，安北將軍、徐州刺史武陵王駿加兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu Province Liu Jun, Prince of Wuling, was additionally appointed Governor of Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen, General Who Pacifies the North Liu Jun, Prince of Wuling and Governor of Xu Province, was additionally appointed Governor of Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，車騎將軍、荊州刺史南譙王義宣進位司空。

translations.literal: On the day bingyin, General of the Chariots and Cavalry and Governor of Jing Province Liu Xuanyi, Prince of Nanqiao, was advanced to Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin, General of the Chariots and Cavalry Liu Xuanyi, Prince of Nanqiao and Governor of Jing Province, was advanced to Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬午，左光祿大夫王敬弘薨。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day renwu, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Wang Jinghong died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renwu, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Wang Jinghong died.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，以撫軍參軍劉秀之為梁、南秦二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou of the eighth month, Pacifying-Army staff officer Liu Xiuzhi was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the eighth month, Pacifying-Army staff officer Liu Xiuzhi was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces.

sentences.zh: 甲子，立第十一皇子彧為淮陽王。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the eleventh imperial son, Yu, was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the eleventh imperial son Yu was enfeoffed as Prince of Huaiyang.

sentences.zh: 九月辛未，以尚書右僕射何尚之為尚書左僕射，領軍將軍沈演之遷職，吳興太守劉遵考為領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei of the ninth month, Right Vice Director of the Secretariat He Shangzhi was appointed Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, Commander of the Army Shen Yanzhi was transferred from his post, and Prefect of Wuxing Liu Zunkao was appointed Commander of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the ninth month, Right Vice Director He Shangzhi was appointed Left Vice Director of the Secretariat, Commander of the Army Shen Yanzhi was transferred, and Prefect of Wuxing Liu Zunkao was appointed Commander of the Army.

sentences.zh: 二十六年春正月辛巳，車駕親祠南郊。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-sixth year, on the day xinsi, the imperial carriage in person performed sacrifice at the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the twenty-sixth year, on xinsi, the Emperor in person sacrificed at the southern suburb.

sentences.zh: 二月己亥，車駕陸道幸丹徒，謁京陵。

translations.literal: In the second month, on the day jihai, the imperial carriage traveled by land to Dantu and paid respects at the imperial tombs at Jingling.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month, on jihai, the Emperor traveled overland to Dantu and paid his respects at the imperial tombs at Jingling.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳，[34]詔曰：「朕違北京，二十餘載，雖云密邇，瞻塗莫從。

translations.literal: In the third month, on the day dingsi, [34] an edict said: "I have been distant from the northern capital for more than twenty years; though said to be near, I could not approach the road thither."
translations.idiomatic: In the third month, on dingsi, [34] an edict said: "I have been far from the northern capital for more than twenty years; though it is called close at hand, I have had no path by which to go and look upon it."

sentences.zh: 今因四表無塵，時和歲稔，復獲拜奉舊塋，展罔極之思，饗讌故老，申追遠之懷。

translations.literal: Now because the four quarters are without dust, the seasons are harmonious and the year abundant, I have again been able to pay reverence at the old tombs, extend boundless filial thought, feast and entertain the old elders, and express feelings of honoring the distant past.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the realm is at peace, the seasons are mild and the harvest plentiful, I have again been able to pay reverence at the ancestral tombs, fulfill boundless filial devotion, feast the elders of former days, and give voice to remembrance of those gone before.

sentences.zh: 固以義兼於桑梓，情加於過沛，永言慷慨，感慰實深。

translations.literal: Truly righteousness encompasses one's native land, affection is added to passing through Pei, words of generous feeling endure, and the sense of gratitude and consolation is truly deep.
translations.idiomatic: Righteous duty embraces one's native soil, affection redoubles on passing through Pei, and words of deep feeling linger — my gratitude and consolation are profound indeed.

sentences.zh: 宜聿宣仁惠，覃被率土。

translations.literal: It is fitting to forthwith proclaim benevolence and grace, extending them over all the realm.
translations.idiomatic: It is fitting to proclaim benevolence and grace at once, extending them over all the realm.

sentences.zh: 其大赦天下。

translations.literal: Let there be a general amnesty throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: A general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 復丹徒縣僑舊今歲租布之半。

translations.literal: Remit half of this year's land tax and cloth levy for émigré natives of Dantu County.
translations.idiomatic: Half of this year's land tax and cloth levy was remitted for émigré natives of Dantu County.

sentences.zh: 行所經縣，蠲田租之半。

translations.literal: In all counties through which the imperial progress passes, remit half of the field tax.
translations.idiomatic: In every county along the imperial route, half of the field tax was remitted.

sentences.zh: 二千石官長並勤勞王務，宜有沾錫。

translations.literal: All grand administrators and chief officials who have diligently toiled in royal affairs should share in bestowed favor.
translations.idiomatic: All grand administrators and chief officials who have diligently served the royal cause should share in imperial favor.

sentences.zh: 登城三戰及大將戰亡墜沒之家，老病單弱者，普加贍卹。

translations.literal: To households of those who fought three assaults on the walls and great generals who died in battle, and the aged, sick, and destitute, add universal relief and condolence.
translations.idiomatic: Universal relief and condolence were granted to households of those who fought three wall assaults and of great generals who fell in battle, and to the aged, sick, and destitute.

sentences.zh: 遣使巡行百姓，問所疾苦。

translations.literal: Dispatch envoys to tour among the people and inquire into their afflictions.
translations.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to tour among the people and inquire into their afflictions.

sentences.zh: 孤老、鰥寡、六疾不能自存者，人賜穀五斛。

translations.literal: Orphans and the elderly, widowers and widows, and those suffering the six kinds of infirmity who cannot support themselves — to each grant five hu of grain.
translations.idiomatic: Orphans and the elderly, widowers and widows, and those suffering the six kinds of infirmity who could not sustain themselves each received five hu of grain.

sentences.zh: 」遣使祭晉故司空忠肅公何無忌之墓。

translations.literal: 」Dispatch envoys to sacrifice at the tomb of the former Jin Minister of Works, Loyal and Solemn Duke He Wuji.
translations.idiomatic: 」Envoys were dispatched to sacrifice at the tomb of the former Jin Minister of Works, Loyal and Solemn Duke He Wuji.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，申南北沛下邳三郡復。

translations.literal: On yichou, remission was granted to the three commanderies of northern and southern Pei and Xiapi.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, tax remission was granted to the three commanderies of northern and southern Pei and Xiapi.

sentences.zh: 又詔曰：「京口肇祥自古，著符近代，衿帶江山，表裏華甸，經塗四達，利盡淮、海，城邑高明，土風淳壹，苞總形勝，實唯名都。

translations.literal: Another edict said: "Jingkou has been the source of auspicious signs since antiquity, and its emblem was manifest in recent times; girdled by rivers and mountains, it faces the flowering heartland, its roads reach four directions, its benefits extend fully to the Huai and the sea, its cities and towns are lofty and bright, its local customs pure and unified — gathering all strategic advantages, it is truly a famed capital.
translations.idiomatic: Another edict said: "Jingkou has been a source of auspicious signs since antiquity and bore its emblem in recent times; girdled by rivers and mountains and facing the heartland, its roads reach in every direction and its advantages extend to the Huai and the sea. Its cities are lofty, its customs pure — gathering every strategic advantage, it is truly a famed capital.

sentences.zh: 故能光宅靈心，克昌帝業。

translations.literal: Therefore it could make the spirit dwell in brightness and succeed in flourishing the imperial enterprise.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore it could make the imperial spirit dwell in brightness and succeed in flourishing the dynastic enterprise.

sentences.zh: 頃年岳牧遷回，軍民徙散，廛里廬宇，不逮往日。

translations.literal: In recent years provincial governors have shifted back and forth, soldiers and civilians have scattered in migration, and markets, lanes, and dwellings no longer match former days.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years provincial governors have come and gone, soldiers and civilians have scattered, and markets, lanes, and dwellings no longer match former days.

sentences.zh: 皇基舊鄉，地兼蕃重，宜令殷阜，式崇形望。

translations.literal: The old home of the imperial foundation, its land both substantial and weighty — it should be made prosperous and its splendid reputation elevated.
translations.idiomatic: As the old home of the imperial foundation, its territory is both substantial and weighty; it should be made prosperous and its splendid standing restored.

sentences.zh: 可募諸州樂移者數千家，給以田宅，并蠲復。」

translations.literal: Recruit from various provinces several thousand households willing to relocate, grant them fields and dwellings, and also remit taxes and corvée."
translations.idiomatic: Several thousand households willing to relocate may be recruited from the provinces, granted fields and dwellings, and given remission of taxes and corvée."

sentences.zh: 五月丙寅，詔曰：「吾生於此城。

translations.literal: In the fifth month, on bingyin, an edict said: "I was born in this city.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month, on bingyin, an edict said: "I was born in this city.

sentences.zh: 及盧循肆亂，害流茲境。

translations.literal: When Lu Xun wreaked chaos, harm spread through this region.
translations.idiomatic: When Lu Xun raised rebellion, harm spread through this region.

sentences.zh: 先帝以桑梓根本，實同休戚，復以蒙稚，猥同艱難，情義繾綣，夷險兼備，舊物遺蹤，猶存心目。

translations.literal: The former emperor took this native place as foundation — truly sharing fortune and misfortune alike — and I as well, in my tender youth, unworthily shared those hardships; affection and obligation were closely bound, through ease and peril alike; traces of former things still remain in mind and eye.
translations.idiomatic: The former emperor took this native place as his root and truly shared its fortune and misfortune; I too, though still a child, unworthily shared those hardships. Affection and obligation were closely bound through ease and peril alike, and traces of former days still live in my mind and eye.

sentences.zh: 歲月不居，逝踰三紀，時人故老，與運零落。

translations.literal: Years and months do not linger; more than three sixty-year cycles have passed; the elders of those times have fallen away with fate.
translations.idiomatic: Years and months do not linger; more than three sixty-year cycles have passed, and the elders of those days have fallen away with the times.

sentences.zh: 眷惟既往，倍深感歎。

translations.literal: Gazing upon what has gone before, I am doubly moved to deep sighing.
translations.idiomatic: Looking back on what has gone before, I am doubly moved to deep sighing.

sentences.zh: 可搜訪于時士庶文武今尚存者，具以名聞。

translations.literal: Search out civil and military gentry and commoners of that time who still survive, and report their names in full.
translations.idiomatic: Search out civil and military gentry and commoners of that time who still survive, and report their names in full.

sentences.zh: 人身已亡而子孫見在，優量賜賚之。

translations.literal: Where the person himself is dead but descendants survive, grant generous rewards by measure.
translations.idiomatic: Where the person himself is dead but descendants survive, grant generous rewards as appropriate.

sentences.zh: 」車駕水路發丹徒，壬午，至京師。

translations.literal: 」The imperial carriage set out from Dantu by water; on renwu, it reached the capital.
translations.idiomatic: 」The Emperor set out from Dantu by water; on renwu, he reached the capital.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，婆皇國，壬辰，婆達國，並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the state of Bapong; on renchen, the state of Bada — both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, the state of Bapong; on renchen, the state of Bada — both sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛未，以江州刺史廬陵王紹為南徐州刺史，廣陵王誕為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: In autumn, on xinwei of the seventh month, Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Jiang Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province, and Prince of Guangling Dan Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on xinwei in the seventh month, Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Jiang Province, was appointed Governor of Southern Xu Province, and Prince of Guangling Dan Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 八月己酉，以中護軍建平王宏為江州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiyou of the eighth month, Central Protector of the Army Prince of Jianping Hong was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the eighth month, Central Protector of the Army Prince of Jianping Hong was appointed Governor of Jiang Province.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，以南豐王朗為湘州刺史。

translations.literal: On guichou, Prince of Nanfeng Lang was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou, Prince of Nanfeng Lang was appointed Governor of Xiang Province.

sentences.zh: 冬十月，廣陵王誕改封隨郡王。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, Prince of Guangling Dan was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Suí Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, Prince of Guangling Dan was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Suí Commandery.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，以中軍將軍、揚州刺史始興王濬為征北將軍、開府儀同三司、南徐兗二州刺史，南徐州刺史廬陵王紹為揚州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiachen, Central Army General and Governor of Yang Province Prince of Shixing Jun was appointed Campaigning-North General with an office equal to the Three Excellencies and Governor of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Governor of Southern Xu Province Prince of Luling Shao was appointed Governor of Yang Province.
