translations.idiomatic: On jiachen, Central Army General and Governor of Yang Province Prince of Shixing Jun was made Campaigning-North General with an office equal to the Three Excellencies and Governor of Southern Xu and Yan provinces; Governor of Southern Xu Province Prince of Luling Shao was appointed Governor of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 二十七年春正月辛未，制交、寧二州假板郡縣，俸祿聽依臺除。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-seventh year, on xinwei, a regulation was set for provisional appointment commanderies and counties in Jiao and Ning provinces: salaries were to follow capital appointments.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the twenty-seventh year, on xinwei, a regulation was set for provisional commanderies and counties in Jiao and Ning provinces: salaries were to follow capital appointments.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，百濟國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On xinmao, the state of Baekje sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao, the state of Baekje sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 二月辛丑，右將軍、豫州刺史南平王鑠進號平西將軍。

translations.literal: On xinchou of the second month, Right General and Governor of Yu Province Prince of Nanping Shuo was advanced in rank to General Who Pacifies the West.
translations.idiomatic: On xinchou in the second month, Right General and Governor of Yu Province Prince of Nanping Shuo was advanced to General Who Pacifies the West.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，[35]索虜寇汝南諸郡，陳南頓二郡太守鄭琨、汝陽潁川二郡太守郭道隱委守走。

translations.literal: On xinhai, [35] the Northern Wei raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, Administrator of the two commanderies of Chen and Nandun, and Guo Daoyin, Administrator of the two commanderies of Ruyang and Yingchuan, abandoned their posts and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai, [35] the Northern Wei raided the commanderies of Runan; Zheng Kun, Administrator of Chen and Nandun, and Guo Daoyin, Administrator of Ruyang and Yingchuan, abandoned their posts and fled.

sentences.zh: 索虜攻懸瓠城，行汝南郡事陳憲拒之。

translations.literal: The Northern Wei attacked Xuanyuan city; Chen Xian, acting Administrator of Runan, resisted them.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Wei attacked Xuanyuan; Chen Xian, acting Administrator of Runan, resisted them.

sentences.zh: 以軍興減百官俸三分之一。

translations.literal: Because of military mobilization, all officials' salaries were reduced by one third.
translations.idiomatic: Because of military mobilization, all officials' salaries were reduced by one third.

sentences.zh: 三月乙丑，淮南太守諸葛闡求減俸祿同內百官，於是州及郡縣丞尉並悉同減。

translations.literal: On yichou of the third month, Administrator of Huainan Zhuge Chan requested that salaries be reduced equal to inner court officials; thereupon provincial, commandery, and county assistants and constables were all reduced alike.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou in the third month, Administrator of Huainan Zhuge Chan requested that salaries be reduced to match those of inner court officials; thereupon assistants and constables at the provincial, commandery, and county levels were all reduced alike.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，罷國子學。

translations.literal: On wuyin, the Imperial Academy was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, the Imperial Academy was abolished.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，以新除吏部尚書蕭思話為護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On yiyou, the newly appointed Minister of Personnel Xiao Sihua was appointed Protector of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou, the newly appointed Minister of Personnel Xiao Sihua was appointed Protector of the Army.

sentences.zh: 夏四月壬子，安北將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍。

translations.literal: In summer, on renzi of the fourth month, Pacifying-North General and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces Prince of Wuling Jun was demoted in rank to General Who Guards the Army.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on renzi in the fourth month, Pacifying-North General and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces Prince of Wuling Jun was demoted to General Who Guards the Army.

translations.literal: Annotation marker 36.
translations.idiomatic: Textual annotation marker 36.

sentences.zh: 六月丁酉，侍中蕭斌為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On dingyou of the sixth month, Palace Attendant Xiao Bin was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou in the sixth month, Palace Attendant Xiao Bin was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 秋七月庚午，遣寧朔將軍王玄謨北伐。

translations.literal: In autumn, on gengwu of the seventh month, Barbarian-Pacifying General Wang Xuanyao was sent on the northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on gengwu in the seventh month, Barbarian-Pacifying General Wang Xuanyao was dispatched on the northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 太尉江夏王義恭出次彭城，總統諸軍。

translations.literal: Grand Commandant Prince of Jiangxia Yigong encamped at Pengcheng, overall commanding the armies.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Prince of Jiangxia Yigong encamped at Pengcheng as overall commander of the armies.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，索虜碻磝戍委城走。

translations.literal: On yihai, the Northern Wei garrison at Que'ao abandoned the city and fled.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai, the Northern Wei garrison at Que'ao abandoned the city and fled.

sentences.zh: 冬閏月癸亥，玄謨攻滑臺，不克，為虜所敗，退還碻磝。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month of winter, on guihai, Xuanyao attacked Huatai but could not capture it; he was defeated by the barbarians and withdrew to Que'ao.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month of winter, on guihai, Xuanyao attacked Huatai but could not take it; he was defeated by the enemy and withdrew to Que'ao.

sentences.zh: 辛未，雍州刺史隨王誕遣軍攻弘農城，克之。

translations.literal: On xinwei, Governor of Yong Province Prince of Suí Dan sent troops to attack Hongnong city and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei, Governor of Yong Province Prince of Suí Dan sent troops to attack Hongnong and captured it.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，又克關城。

translations.literal: On bingxu, they also captured Guan city.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu, they also captured Guan.

sentences.zh: 十一月戊子，索虜陷鄒山，魯、陽平二郡太守崔邪利沒。

translations.literal: On wuzi of the eleventh month, the Northern Wei captured Zou Mountain; Cui Xieli, Administrator of the two commanderies of Lu and Yangping, was captured.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi in the eleventh month, the Northern Wei captured Zou Mountain; Cui Xieli, Administrator of Lu and Yangping, was taken captive.

sentences.zh: 甲午，隨王誕所遣軍又攻陝城，克之。

translations.literal: On jiawu, the troops sent by Prince of Suí Dan again attacked Shan city and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu, the troops sent by Prince of Suí Dan again attacked Shan and captured it.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，左軍將軍劉康祖於壽陽尉武戍與虜戰敗見殺。

translations.literal: On guimao, Left-Army General Liu Kangzu was defeated in battle with the barbarians at Yuwu garrison in Shouyang and was killed.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao, Left-Army General Liu Kangzu was defeated in battle with the enemy at Yuwu garrison in Shouyang and was killed.

sentences.zh: 丁未，大赦天下。

translations.literal: On dingwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei, a general amnesty was proclaimed throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊午，內外纂嚴。

translations.literal: On wuwu of the twelfth month, strict martial alert was imposed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu in the twelfth month, strict martial alert was imposed within and without the capital.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，冗從僕射胡崇之、太子積弩將軍臧澄之、建威將軍毛熙祚於盱眙與虜戰敗，並見殺。

translations.literal: On yichou, Supernumerary Attendant Hu Chongzhi, Heir Apparent's Strong-Crossbow General Zang Chengzhi, and Establishing-Prestige General Mao Xizuo were defeated in battle with the barbarians at Xuyi and were all killed.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou, Supernumerary Attendant Hu Chongzhi, Heir Apparent's Strong-Crossbow General Zang Chengzhi, and Establishing-Prestige General Mao Xizuo were defeated by the enemy at Xuyi and were all killed.

sentences.zh: 庚午，虜偽主率大眾至瓜步。

translations.literal: On gengwu, the barbarian pretender ruler led a great host to Guabu.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu, the Northern Wei ruler led a great host to Guabu.

sentences.zh: 壬午，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: On renwu, martial alert was proclaimed within and without.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, martial alert was proclaimed within and without the capital.

sentences.zh: 二十八年春正月丙戌朔，以寇逼不朝會。

translations.literal: On the first day bingxu of the first month of spring of the twenty-eighth year, because of the enemy's press the court assembly was not held.
translations.idiomatic: On the new moon bingxu in the first month of spring in the twenty-eighth year, the court assembly was not held because of the enemy's advance.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，索虜自瓜步退走。

translations.literal: On dinghai, the Northern Wei withdrew from Guabu.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai, the Northern Wei withdrew from Guabu.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，攻圍盱眙城。

translations.literal: On dingyou, they attacked and besieged Xuyi city.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, they attacked and besieged Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 是月，寧朔將軍王玄謨自碻磝退還歷下。

translations.literal: That month, Barbarian-Pacifying General Wang Xuanyao withdrew from Que'ao and returned to Lixia.
translations.idiomatic: That month, Barbarian-Pacifying General Wang Xuanyao withdrew from Que'ao and returned to Lixia.

sentences.zh: 二月丙辰，索虜自盱眙奔走。

translations.literal: On bingchen of the second month, the Northern Wei fled in disorder from Xuyi.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen in the second month, the Northern Wei fled in disorder from Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，詔曰：「玁狁孔熾，難及數州，眷言念之，鑒寐興悼。

translations.literal: On guiyou, an edict said: "The Xianyun rage fiercely; calamity reaches several provinces — turning my thoughts to this, I am moved to grief waking and sleeping.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou, an edict said: "The Xianyun rage fiercely and calamity has reached several provinces; turning my thoughts to this, I am moved to grief waking and sleeping.

sentences.zh: 凶羯痍挫，迸跡遠奔，彫傷之民，宜時振理。

translations.literal: The vicious Jie, wounded and broken, have scattered far in flight; the people carved by suffering should at once be restored and put in order.
translations.idiomatic: The vicious foe, wounded and broken, has scattered far in flight; the people carved by suffering should at once be restored and put in order.

sentences.zh: 凡遭寇賊郡縣，令還復居業，封屍掩骼，賑贍饑流。

translations.literal: In all commanderies and counties that suffered bandits and raiders, order them to return and resume their occupations; bury the exposed dead and cover the bones; provide relief to the hungry and displaced.
translations.idiomatic: In all commanderies and counties that suffered raiders, order the people to return and resume their occupations; bury the exposed dead and cover the bones; and provide relief to the hungry and displaced.

sentences.zh: 東作方始，務盡勸課。

translations.literal: Eastern cultivation is just beginning — exert all effort in encouraging agricultural levies.
translations.idiomatic: Spring planting is just beginning — exert every effort in encouraging the agricultural levy.

sentences.zh: 貸給之宜，事從優厚。

translations.literal: As to lending and grants, matters should follow generous treatment.
translations.idiomatic: As to loans and grants, generous treatment should be applied.

sentences.zh: 其流寓江、淮者，並聽即屬，并蠲復稅調。

translations.literal: Those sojourning along the Yangzi and Huai — all are permitted to register immediately where they are, and taxes and corvée are also remitted.
translations.idiomatic: Those sojourning along the Yangzi and Huai are all permitted to register where they are, and taxes and corvée are also remitted.

sentences.zh: 」甲戌，太尉、領司徒江夏王義恭降為驃騎將軍、開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: 」On jiaxu, Grand Commandant and concurrent Director of the Masters Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was demoted to Rapid-Cavalry General with an office equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: 」On jiaxu, Grand Commandant and concurrent Director of the Masters Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was demoted to Rapid-Cavalry General with an office equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，鎮軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號北中郎將。

translations.literal: On xinsi, General Who Guards the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces Prince of Wuling Jun was demoted in rank to North Centre Commander.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi, General Who Guards the Army and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces Prince of Wuling Jun was demoted to North Centre Commander.

sentences.zh: 壬午，車駕幸瓜步，是日解嚴。

translations.literal: On renwu, the imperial carriage visited Guabu; that day martial alert was lifted.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, the Emperor visited Guabu; that day martial alert was lifted.

sentences.zh: 三月乙酉，車駕還宮。

translations.literal: On yiyou of the third month, the imperial carriage returned to the palace.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the third month, the Emperor returned to the palace.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，征北將軍始興王濬解南兗州。

translations.literal: On renchen, Campaigning-North General Prince of Shixing Jun relinquished Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen, Campaigning-North General Prince of Shixing Jun relinquished Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 庚子，以輔國將軍臧質為雍州刺史。

translations.literal: On gengzi, Assisting-the-State General Zang Zhi was appointed Governor of Yong Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengzi, Assisting-the-State General Zang Zhi was appointed Governor of Yong Province.

sentences.zh: 戊申，徐州刺史武陵王駿為南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: On wushen, Governor of Xu Province Prince of Wuling Jun was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Governor of Xu Province Prince of Wuling Jun was appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，護軍將軍蕭思話為撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史。

translations.literal: On jiayin, Protector of the Army Xiao Sihua was appointed Pacifying-Army General and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin, Protector of the Army Xiao Sihua was appointed Pacifying-Army General and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces.

sentences.zh: 夏四月癸酉，婆達國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In summer, on guiyou of the fourth month, the state of Bada sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on guiyou in the fourth month, the state of Bada sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 索虜偽寧南將軍魯爽、中書郎魯秀歸順。

translations.literal: The Northern Wei's false Pacifying-South General Lu Shuang and Secretariat Gentleman Lu Xiu submitted and came over.
translations.idiomatic: The Northern Wei's Pacifying-South General Lu Shuang and Secretariat Gentleman Lu Xiu defected and submitted.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，以爽為司州刺史。

translations.literal: On wuyin, Shuang was appointed Governor of Si Province.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin, Shuang was appointed Governor of Si Province.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉，亡命司馬順則自號齊王，據梁鄒城。

translations.literal: On yiyou of the fifth month, the outlaw Sima Shunze declared himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou city.
translations.idiomatic: On yiyou in the fifth month, the outlaw Sima Shunze declared himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，婆皇國，戊戌，河南王，並遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the state of Bapong; on wuxu, the King of Henan — both sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi, the state of Bapong; on wuxu, the King of Henan — both sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: [37]己巳，驃騎將軍江夏王義恭領南兗州刺史。

translations.literal: [37] On jisi, Rapid-Cavalry General Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was additionally appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.
translations.idiomatic: [37] On jisi, Rapid-Cavalry General Prince of Jiangxia Yigong was additionally appointed Governor of Southern Yan Province.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以尚書左僕射何尚之為尚書令，太子詹事徐湛之為尚書僕射、護軍將軍。

translations.literal: On wushen, Left Vice Director of the Masters He Shangzhi was appointed Director of the Masters, and Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household Xu Zhanzhi was appointed Vice Director of the Masters and Protector of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On wushen, Left Vice Director of the Masters He Shangzhi was appointed Director of the Masters, and Supervisor of the Heir Apparent's Household Xu Zhanzhi Vice Director of the Masters and Protector of the Army.

sentences.zh: 壬子，以後將軍隨王誕為安南將軍、廣州刺史。

translations.literal: On renzi, Rear General Prince of Suí Dan was appointed Pacifying-South General and Governor of Guang Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi, Rear General Prince of Suí Dan was appointed Pacifying-South General and Governor of Guang Province.

sentences.zh: 六月壬戌，以北中郎將武陵王駿為江州刺史，以振武將軍、秦郡太守劉興祖為青、冀二州刺史。

translations.literal: On renxu of the sixth month, North Centre Commander Prince of Wuling Jun was appointed Governor of Jiang Province, and Shaking-Arms General and Administrator of Qin Commandery Liu Xingzu was appointed Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On renxu in the sixth month, North Centre Commander Prince of Wuling Jun was appointed Governor of Jiang Province, and Shaking-Arms General and Administrator of Qin Commandery Liu Xingzu Governor of Qing and Ji provinces.

sentences.zh: 秋七月甲辰，安東將軍倭王倭濟進號安東大將軍。

translations.literal: In autumn, on jiachen of the seventh month, Pacifying-the-East General King Wo of Wa was advanced in rank to Pacifying-the-East Grand General.
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, on jiachen in the seventh month, Pacifying-the-East General King Wo of Wa was advanced to Pacifying-the-East Grand General.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，梁鄒平，斬司馬順則。

translations.literal: On guihai of the eighth month, Liangzou was pacified and Sima Shunze was beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai in the eighth month, Liangzou was pacified and Sima Shunze was beheaded.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，高麗國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on guihai, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guihai, the state of Goguryeo sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，曲赦二兗、徐、豫、青、冀六州。

translations.literal: On renyin of the eleventh month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the six provinces of the two Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the eleventh month, a partial amnesty was proclaimed for the six provinces of the two Yan, Xu, Yu, Qing, and Ji.

sentences.zh: 是冬，徙彭城流民於瓜步，淮西流民於姑孰，合萬許家。

translations.literal: That winter, displaced people from Pengcheng were relocated to Guabu and those from west of the Huai to Guchu — together about ten thousand households.
translations.idiomatic: That winter, displaced people from Pengcheng were relocated to Guabu and those from west of the Huai to Guchu — together about ten thousand households.

sentences.zh: 二十九年春正月甲午，詔曰：「經寇六州，居業未立，[38]仍值災澇，饑困荐臻。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the twenty-ninth year, on jiawu, an edict said: "Having endured raids across six provinces, livelihoods are not yet established; [38] moreover disaster and flooding have struck, and hunger and distress come one upon another.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the twenty-ninth year, on jiawu, an edict said: "Having endured raids across six provinces, livelihoods are not yet established; [38] moreover floods and disaster have struck, and hunger and distress come one upon another.

sentences.zh: 可速符諸鎮，優量救卹。

translations.literal: Quickly send orders to all garrison commands for generous measured relief and condolence.
translations.idiomatic: Quickly send orders to all garrison commands for generous relief and condolence.

sentences.zh: 今農事行興，務盡地利。

translations.literal: Now agricultural work is beginning — exert every effort to make full use of the land's advantages.
translations.idiomatic: Now agricultural work is resuming — exert every effort to make full use of the land.

sentences.zh: 若須田種，隨宜給之。」

translations.literal: If seed for fields is needed, grant it as appropriate."
translations.idiomatic: If seed is needed for the fields, grant it as appropriate."

sentences.zh: 二月庚申，虜帥拓跋燾死。

translations.literal: On gengshen of the second month, the barbarian leader Tuoba Tao died.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen in the second month, the barbarian leader Tuoba Tao died.

sentences.zh: 戊午，[39]立第十二皇子休仁為建安王。

translations.literal: On wuwu, [39] the twelfth prince Xiuren was enfeoffed as Prince of Jian'an.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu, [39] the twelfth prince Xiuren was enfeoffed as Prince of Jian'an.

sentences.zh: 夏四月戊午，訶羅單國遣使獻方物。

translations.literal: In summer, on wuwu of the fourth month, the state of Heluodan sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, on wuwu in the fourth month, the state of Heluodan sent envoys bearing tribute.

sentences.zh: 以驃騎參軍張永為冀州刺史。

translations.literal: Rapid-Cavalry Staff Officer Zhang Yong was appointed Governor of Ji Province.
translations.idiomatic: Rapid-Cavalry Staff Officer Zhang Yong was appointed Governor of Ji Province.

sentences.zh: 五月甲午，罷湘州并荊州。

translations.literal: On jiawu of the fifth month, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the fifth month, Xiang Province was abolished and merged into Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 以始興、臨賀、始安三郡屬廣州，丙申，詔曰：「惡稔身滅，戎醜常數，虐虜窮凶，著於自昔。

translations.literal: The three commanderies of Shixing, Linhe, and Shi'an were placed under Guang Province; on bingchen, an edict said: "When wickedness accumulates, the body perishes — barbarian ugliness is a constant of the ages; the cruel barbarians' utter viciousness has been manifest since of old.
translations.idiomatic: The three commanderies of Shixing, Linhe, and Shi'an were placed under Guang Province; on bingchen, an edict said: "When wickedness accumulates, the body perishes — barbarian treachery is an age-old constant, and the cruel enemy's utter viciousness has been manifest since of old.

sentences.zh: 未勞資斧，已伏天誅，子孫相殘，親黨離貳，關、洛偽帥，並懷內款，河朔遺民，注誠請効。

translations.literal: Before we had even toiled to wield our axes, heaven's judgment had already struck them down; their descendants slaughter one another, kin and allies turn against each other; the false commanders of Guanzhong and Luoyang all harbor secret intent to surrender; the remnant people of the Hebei north pour out their loyalty and beg to serve.
translations.idiomatic: Before we could even raise our axes in war, heaven's judgment had already fallen; their descendants turn on one another, kin and allies split apart; the puppet commanders of Guanzhong and Luoyang all wish secretly to submit; and the surviving people of the north pour out their hearts and beg to serve.

sentences.zh: 拯溺蕩穢，今其會也。

translations.literal: To rescue the drowning and sweep away the foul — now is the moment.
translations.idiomatic: To save the drowning and cleanse the land — the time is now.

sentences.zh: 可符驃騎、司空二府，各部分所統，東西應接。

translations.literal: Orders should be sent to the two offices of the Rapid-Cavalry General and the Minister of Works, each to deploy the forces under their command in mutual support east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Dispatch orders to the Rapid-Cavalry General and the Minister of Works, each to move the forces under his command into coordinated support east and west.

sentences.zh: 歸義建績者，隨勞酬獎。

translations.literal: Those who come over in loyalty and achieve merit shall be rewarded according to their exertions.
translations.idiomatic: Those who submit in good faith and distinguish themselves shall be rewarded according to their service.

sentences.zh: 」是月，京邑雨水。

translations.literal: "] In this month, the capital region suffered flooding rains.
translations.idiomatic: "] That month the capital was inundated by rain.

sentences.zh: 六月己酉，遣部司巡行，賜樵米，給船。

translations.literal: On the day jiyou of the sixth month, department officials were dispatched on inspection tours, granting firewood and grain and supplying boats.
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou in the sixth month, departmental officers were sent on inspection tours to distribute firewood and grain and provide boats.

sentences.zh: 撫軍將軍蕭思話率眾北伐。

translations.literal: Pacifying-Army General Xiao Sihua led his forces on a northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: Pacifying-Army General Xiao Sihua led an army north.

sentences.zh: 以征北從事中郎劉瑀為益州刺史。

translations.literal: Campaigning-North Staff Officer Liu Yu was appointed Governor of Yi Province.
translations.idiomatic: Campaigning-North Staff Officer Liu Yu was appointed Governor of Yi Province.

sentences.zh: 秋七月壬辰，汝陰王渾改封武昌王，淮陽王彧改封湘東王。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on the day renchen, Prince of Ruyin Hun was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Wuchang, and Prince of Huaiyang Yu as Prince of Xiangdong.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, on renchen, Prince of Ruyin Hun was re-enfeoffed as Prince of Wuchang, and Prince of Huaiyang Yu as Prince of Xiangdong.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，省大司農、太子僕、廷尉監官。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the offices of Grand Minister of Agriculture, Grand Master of the Heir Apparent's Household, and Supervisor of the Court of Judicial Review were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou, the posts of Grand Minister of Agriculture, Grand Master of the Heir Apparent's Household, and Supervisor of the Court of Judicial Review were abolished.

sentences.zh: 八月丁卯，蕭思話攻碻磝，不拔，退還。

translations.literal: On the day dingmao of the eighth month, Xiao Sihua attacked Que'ao but could not take it and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao in the eighth month, Xiao Sihua attacked Que'ao, failed to capture it, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 九月丁亥，以平西將軍吐谷渾拾寅為安西將軍、秦河二州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day dinghai of the ninth month, General Who Pacifies the West Shiyin of Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Qin and He provinces.
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai in the ninth month, General Who Pacifies the West Shiyin of Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Qin and He provinces.

sentences.zh: 己丑，撫軍將軍、徐兗二州刺史蕭思話加冀州刺史，兗州如故。

translations.literal: On the day jichou, Pacifying-Army General and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces Xiao Sihua was additionally appointed Governor of Ji Province, Yan Province remaining as before.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou, Pacifying-Army General Xiao Sihua, Governor of Xu and Yan provinces, was additionally appointed Governor of Ji Province while retaining Yan.

sentences.zh: 冬十月癸亥，司州刺史魯爽攻虎牢不拔，退還。

translations.literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the day guihai, Governor of Si Province Lu Shuang attacked Hulao but could not take it and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on guihai, Governor of Si Province Lu Shuang attacked Hulao, failed to capture it, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 十一月壬寅，揚州刺史廬陵王紹薨。

translations.literal: On the day renyin of the eleventh month, Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Yang Province, died.
translations.idiomatic: On renyin in the eleventh month, Prince of Luling Shao, Governor of Yang Province, died.

sentences.zh: 十二月辛未，以驃騎將軍、南兗州刺史江夏王義恭為大將軍、南徐州刺史，錄尚書事如故。

translations.literal: On the day xinwei of the twelfth month, Rapid-Cavalry General and Governor of Southern Yan Province Prince of Jiangxia Liu Yigong was appointed Grand General and Governor of Southern Xu Province, retaining his post as Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On xinwei in the twelfth month, Rapid-Cavalry General Liu Yigong, Prince of Jiangxia and Governor of Southern Yan Province, was appointed Grand General and Governor of Southern Xu Province, retaining his directorship of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 三十年春正月戊寅，以司空、荊州刺史南譙王義宣為司徒、中軍將軍、揚州刺史。

translations.literal: In the first month of spring of the thirtieth year, on the day wuyin, Minister of Works and Governor of Jing Province Prince of Nanqiao Liu Yixuan was appointed Grand Minister, Central Army General, and Governor of Yang Province.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of spring in the thirtieth year, on wuyin, Minister of Works Liu Yixuan, Prince of Nanqiao and Governor of Jing Province, was appointed Grand Minister, Central Army General, and Governor of Yang Province.

sentences.zh: 以南兗州并南徐州。

translations.literal: Southern Yan Province was merged into Southern Xu Province.
translations.idiomatic: Southern Yan Province was merged into Southern Xu Province.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，以領軍將軍劉遵考為平西將軍、豫州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day gengchen, Commander of the Army Liu Zunkao was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Yu Province.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen, Commander of the Army Liu Zunkao was appointed General Who Pacifies the West and Governor of Yu Province.

sentences.zh: 壬午，以征北將軍、南徐州刺史始興王濬為衛將軍、荊州刺史。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, Campaigning-North General and Governor of Southern Xu Province Prince of Shixing Liu Jun was appointed Guard General and Governor of Jing Province.
translations.idiomatic: On renwu, Campaigning-North General Liu Jun, Prince of Shixing and Governor of Southern Xu Province, was appointed Guard General and Governor of Jing Province.

sentences.zh: 戊子，江州刺史武陵王駿統眾軍伐西陽蠻。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, Prince of Wuling Liu Jun, Governor of Jiang Province, commanded the army in an attack on the Western Yang barbarians.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi, Prince of Wuling Liu Jun, Governor of Jiang Province, led the army against the Western Yang tribes.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以豫州刺史南平王鑠為撫軍將軍、領軍將軍。

translations.literal: On the day guisi, Governor of Yu Province Prince of Nanping Liu Shuo was appointed Pacifying-Army General and Commander of the Army.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi, Prince of Nanping Liu Shuo, Governor of Yu Province, was appointed Pacifying-Army General and Commander of the Army.

sentences.zh: 青、徐州饑，二月壬子，遣運部賑卹。

translations.literal: Qing and Xu provinces suffered famine; on the day renzi of the second month, the transport department was dispatched to grant relief.
translations.idiomatic: Qing and Xu provinces suffered famine; on renzi in the second month, transport officials were sent to grant relief.

sentences.zh: 甲子，上崩于含章殿。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, the Emperor died in Hanzhang Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi, the Emperor died in Hanzhang Palace.

sentences.zh: 時年四十七。

translations.literal: He was forty-seven years old.
translations.idiomatic: He was forty-seven.

sentences.zh: 諡曰景皇帝，廟曰中宗。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Emperor Jing; his temple name Zhongzong.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous title Emperor Jing and the temple name Zhongzong.

sentences.zh: 三月癸巳，葬長寧陵。

translations.literal: On the day guisi of the third month, he was buried at Changning Mausoleum.
translations.idiomatic: On guisi in the third month, he was buried at Changning Mausoleum.

sentences.zh: 世祖踐阼，追改諡及廟號。

translations.literal: When Emperor Shizu ascended the throne, the posthumous title and temple name were retroactively changed.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Shizu took the throne, his predecessor's posthumous title and temple name were revised.

sentences.zh: 史臣曰：太祖幼年特秀，顧無保傅之嚴，而天授和敏之姿，自禀君人之德。

translations.literal: The Historian says: In his youth the Taizu was exceptionally gifted; though he lacked the stern tutelage of guardians and teachers, heaven had endowed him with a harmonious and quick-witted nature, and he was born with the virtue of a ruler of men.
translations.idiomatic: The Historian writes: The Taizu was precociously brilliant. He had no strict tutors, yet heaven had given him a gentle, keen temperament, and he possessed by nature the virtue of a sovereign.

sentences.zh: 及正位南面，歷年長久，綱維備舉，條禁明密，罰有恒科，爵無濫品。

translations.literal: Once he took the throne and faced south, his reign lasted many years; the framework of governance was fully established, statutes and prohibitions were clear and strict, punishments followed fixed standards, and ranks were never bestowed without warrant.
translations.idiomatic: Once enthroned, he ruled for many years. The institutions of government were complete, laws and prohibitions precise, punishments followed fixed standards, and ranks were never granted without cause.

sentences.zh: 故能內清外晏，四海謐如也。

translations.literal: Thus within was clarity and without was peace; the four seas were tranquil.
translations.idiomatic: Within the realm there was order; without, peace — and the four seas were still.

sentences.zh: 昔漢氏東京常稱建武、永平故事，自茲厥後，亦每以元嘉為言，斯固盛矣。

translations.literal: Formerly the Eastern Han often invoked the precedents of Jianwu and Yongping; from that time onward, people likewise spoke of the Yuanjia era — truly a flourishing age.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Han had often held up the reigns of Jianwu and Yongping as models; afterward men spoke just as often of Yuanjia — an age indeed of greatness.

sentences.zh: 授將遣帥，乖分閫之命，才謝光武，而遙制兵略，至於攻日戰時，莫不仰聽成旨。

translations.literal: Yet in appointing generals and dispatching commanders, he departed from the principle of entrusting each with independent command; his talent fell short of Emperor Guangwu's, yet he controlled military strategy from afar — when the day for attack or the hour for battle came, none failed to look upward and await the final word.
translations.idiomatic: Yet in appointing generals and sending out commanders he violated the rule that each border post should hold independent authority. His gifts did not match those of Emperor Guangwu, yet he directed strategy from afar; on the day of battle, every commander waited on his word from the capital.

sentences.zh: 雖覆師喪旅，將非韓、白，而延寇慼境，抑此之由。

translations.literal: Though armies were destroyed and troops lost — and his generals were no Han Xin or Bai Qi — that the enemy lingered and brought grief to the borders, this too was the reason.
translations.idiomatic: Armies were shattered and campaigns lost — not because his generals lacked the genius of Han Xin or Bai Qi, but because the enemy was allowed to linger and ravage the frontiers. This was the root of it.

sentences.zh: 及至言漏衾衽，難結商豎，雖禍生非慮，蓋亦有以而然也。

translations.literal: When word leaked even from the pillow and bed curtain and enemies hard to unite proved hard to bind, though disaster arose beyond expectation, there was surely cause for it.
translations.idiomatic: When secrets escaped even the imperial bedchamber and hard-won alliances unraveled, calamity may have seemed unforeseen — yet it had its causes.

sentences.zh: 嗚呼哀哉！

translations.literal: Alas! How lamentable!
translations.idiomatic: Alas — how grievous!

sentences.zh: 校勘記

translations.literal: Collation Notes
translations.idiomatic: Textual Collation Notes

sentences.zh: 車駕至京城 孫虨宋書考論云：「當作京邑。

translations.literal: "The imperial carriage came to Jingcheng": Sun Bin's Collation Notes on the Book of Song says: "This should read 'the capital region.'
translations.idiomatic: "The imperial carriage came to Jingcheng": Sun Bin's Collation Notes on the Book of Song says it should read "the capital region."

sentences.zh: 京城則京口矣。

translations.literal: "Jingcheng" would mean Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: "Jingcheng" would refer to Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 」按通鑑作建康。

translations.literal: " According to the Comprehensive Mirror, the text reads Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: " According to the Comprehensive Mirror, the text reads Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 宋書京城往往指京口城，此則指建康。

translations.literal: In the Book of Song, "Jingcheng" often refers to Jingkou; here it refers to Jiankang.
translations.idiomatic: In the Book of Song, "Jingcheng" usually means Jingkou; here it means Jiankang.

sentences.zh: 辛未車駕祠南郊 各本並脫「辛未」二字，據南史、建康實錄、通鑑補。

translations.literal: "On xinwei the imperial carriage sacrificed at the southern suburb": all editions omit the two characters "xinwei"; restored according to the Book of Southern Qi, Veritable Record of Jiankang, and Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: "On xinwei the imperial carriage sacrificed at the southern suburb": all editions drop "xinwei"; restored from the Book of Southern Qi, Veritable Record of Jiankang, and Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 建安太守潘盛有罪伏誅 「潘盛」各本作「潘城」，據少帝紀、徐羨之傳改。

translations.literal: "Chancellor of Jian'an Pan Sheng was guilty and executed": all editions read "Pan Cheng" for "Pan Sheng"; emended according to the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Xu Xianzhi.
translations.idiomatic: "Chancellor of Jian'an Pan Sheng was guilty and executed": all editions have "Pan Cheng" instead of "Pan Sheng"; corrected per the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and Xu Xianzhi's biography.

sentences.zh: 乙卯 各本並作「己卯」，據局本及南史改。

translations.literal: For the date yimao, all editions read jimao; emended according to the Bureau edition and the Book of Southern Qi.
translations.idiomatic: For the date yimao, all editions read jimao; corrected per the Bureau edition and the Book of Southern Qi.

sentences.zh: 按是月丁酉朔，十九日乙卯，無己卯。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month began on dingyou; the nineteenth day was yimao — there was no jimao.
translations.idiomatic: That month began on dingyou; the nineteenth day was yimao. There was no jimao.

sentences.zh: 領平北將軍南徐州刺史 各本並脫「南」字，按彭城王義康傳、建康實錄、通鑑並作南徐州刺史，今據補。

translations.literal: "Concurrently Pacifying-North General and Governor of Southern Xu Province": all editions omit the character "Southern"; according to the biography of Prince of Pengcheng Liu Yikang, Veritable Record of Jiankang, and Comprehensive Mirror, all read Southern Xu Province — now restored.
translations.idiomatic: "Concurrently Pacifying-North General and Governor of Southern Xu Province": all editions drop "Southern"; the biography of Liu Yikang, the Veritable Record of Jiankang, and the Comprehensive Mirror all read Southern Xu Province — now restored.

sentences.zh: 以前征虜司馬尹沖為司州刺史 各本並脫「尹」字，按索虜傳，時尹沖為司州刺史，通鑑同。

translations.literal: "Former Campaigning-Captives Staff Officer Yin Chong was appointed Governor of Si Province": all editions omit the character "Yin"; according to the biography of the Northern Wei, Yin Chong was then Governor of Si Province — the Comprehensive Mirror agrees.
translations.idiomatic: "Former Campaigning-Captives Staff Officer Yin Chong was appointed Governor of Si Province": all editions drop "Yin"; the Northern Wei biography shows Yin Chong held that post at the time, as does the Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 今據補。

translations.literal: Now restored accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: Restored accordingly.

sentences.zh: 征南大將軍檀道濟破索虜於東平壽張 各本並脫「平」字。

translations.literal: "Campaigning-South Grand General Tan Daoji defeated the Northern Wei at Dongping Shouzhang": all editions omit the character "ping."
translations.idiomatic: "Campaigning-South Grand General Tan Daoji defeated the Northern Wei at Dongping Shouzhang": all editions drop "ping."

sentences.zh: 據檀道濟傳補。

translations.literal: Restored according to the biography of Tan Daoji.
translations.idiomatic: Restored from Tan Daoji's biography.

sentences.zh: 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「按檀道濟傳作東平壽張，此『東』下脫『平』字。」

translations.literal: Hong Yixuan's Collation of Discrepancies among the Histories says: "According to the biography of Tan Daoji the text reads Dongping Shouzhang; here the character 'ping' is missing after 'Dong.'"
translations.idiomatic: Hong Yixuan's Collation of Discrepancies among the Histories notes: Tan Daoji's biography reads Dongping Shouzhang; here "ping" is missing after "Dong."

sentences.zh: 苟不深存務本 各本並脫「苟」字，據元龜一九八補。

translations.literal: "If we do not deeply preserve the fundamental work": all editions omit the character "If"; restored according to Yuan Gui 198.
translations.idiomatic: "If we do not deeply preserve the fundamental work": all editions drop "If"; restored from Yuan Gui 198.

sentences.zh: 以吐谷渾慕容延為平東將軍 「慕容延」本書吐谷渾傳作「慕延」。

translations.literal: "Murong Yan of Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Pacifies the East": in this book's biography of Tuyuhun, "Murong Yan" is written "Mu Yan."
translations.idiomatic: "Murong Yan of Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Pacifies the East": this book's Tuyuhun biography writes the name as Mu Yan.

sentences.zh: 魏書作「慕利延」。

translations.literal: The Book of Wei reads "Mu Liyan."
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Wei reads "Mu Liyan."

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾輝伐為鎮軍將軍 各本並脫「谷」字，據前後文例補。

translations.literal: "Huifa of Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Stabilizes the Army": all editions omit the character "gu"; restored according to the pattern of the surrounding text.
translations.idiomatic: "Huifa of Tuyuhun was appointed General Who Stabilizes the Army": all editions drop "gu" from Tuyuhun; restored by context.

sentences.zh: 「輝伐」魏書作「緯代」。

translations.literal: "Huifa" in the Book of Wei is written "Weidai."
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Wei writes the name as Weidai.

sentences.zh: 壬申河南國河西王遣使獻方物 「河西王」各本作「西河王」，據少帝紀景平元年及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。

translations.literal: "On renshen the state of Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys presenting local products": all editions read "King of Xihe" for "King of Hexi"; emended according to the Annals of the Deposed Emperor for the first year of Jingping and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.
translations.idiomatic: "On renshen the state of Henan and the King of Hexi sent envoys bearing tribute": all editions have "King of Xihe" instead of "King of Hexi"; corrected per the Deposed Emperor's annals for Jingping 1 and Juqu Mengxun's biography.

sentences.zh: 亡命馬大玄羣黨數百人寇泰山 三朝本作「泰山」，弘治本、北監本、毛本、殿本、局本作「秦梁」。

translations.literal: "The outlaw Ma Daxuan and several hundred followers raided Mount Tai": the Three Dynasties edition reads "Mount Tai"; the Hongzhi, Northern Directorate, Mao, Palace, and Bureau editions read "Qin and Liang."
translations.idiomatic: "The outlaw Ma Daxuan and several hundred followers raided Mount Tai": the Three Dynasties edition reads Mount Tai; the Hongzhi, Northern Directorate, Mao, Palace, and Bureau editions read Qin and Liang.

sentences.zh: 夏四月乙酉 按是月丁亥朔，無乙酉。

translations.literal: "In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou": according to the calendar, that month began on dinghai — there was no yiyou.
translations.idiomatic: "In the fourth month of summer, on yiyou": that month began on dinghai; there was no yiyou.

sentences.zh: 二十三日己酉，「乙酉」或是「己酉」之譌。

translations.literal: The twenty-third day was jiyou; "yiyou" may be a corruption of "jiyou."
translations.idiomatic: The twenty-third day was jiyou; "yiyou" is likely a corruption of "jiyou."

sentences.zh: 秋七月辛酉 「辛酉」各本並作「乙酉」，據南史改。

translations.literal: "In the seventh month of autumn, on xinyou": all editions read "yiyou" for "xinyou"; emended according to the Book of Southern Qi.
translations.idiomatic: "In the seventh month of autumn, on xinyou": all editions read yiyou instead of xinyou; corrected per the Book of Southern Qi.

sentences.zh: 按是月庚戌朔，初六日辛酉，無「乙酉」。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month began on gengxu; the sixth day was xinyou — there was no "yiyou."
translations.idiomatic: That month began on gengxu; the sixth day was xinyou. There was no yiyou.

sentences.zh: 於益州立南晉壽南新巴北巴西三郡 各本並作「於益州立南晉壽新巴西三郡」。

translations.literal: "In Yi Province the three commanderies of Nanjinshou, Nanxinba, and Beibaxi were established": all editions read "In Yi Province the three commanderies of Nanjinshou, Xinba, and Xi were established."
translations.idiomatic: "In Yi Province the three commanderies of Nanjinshou, Nanxinba, and Beibaxi were established": all editions read Nanjinshou, Xinba, and Xi.

sentences.zh: 孫虨宋書考論云：「據州郡志，是南晉壽、南新巴、北巴西三郡。

translations.literal: Sun Bin's Collation Notes on the Book of Song says: "According to the Monograph on Provinces and Commanderies, these are the three commanderies of Nanjinshou, Nanxinba, and Beibaxi.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Bin's Collation Notes on the Book of Song says: according to the Monograph on Provinces and Commanderies, the three commanderies are Nanjinshou, Nanxinba, and Beibaxi.

sentences.zh: 」按孫說是，今訂正。

translations.literal: " Sun's view is correct; the text is now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: " Sun is correct; the text is now corrected.

sentences.zh: 又此條上云「壬申」，下云「乙亥」。

translations.literal: Moreover, in this entry the text above reads "renshen" and below reads "yihai."
translations.idiomatic: In this entry the line above reads renshen and the line below reads yihai.

sentences.zh: 按是月丙戌朔，無壬申，亦無乙亥。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month began on bingxu — there was neither renshen nor yihai.
translations.idiomatic: That month began on bingxu; there was neither renshen nor yihai.

sentences.zh: 以步兵校尉劉真道為梁南秦二州刺史 「劉真道」各本並作「劉道真」。

translations.literal: "Colonel of Footsoldiers Liu Zhendao was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces": all editions read "Liu Daozhen" for "Liu Zhendao."
translations.idiomatic: "Colonel of Footsoldiers Liu Zhendao was appointed Governor of Liang and Southern Qin provinces": all editions read Liu Daozhen instead of Liu Zhendao.

sentences.zh: 張森楷校勘記云：「當作劉真道，見劉懷肅傳，下十八年亦作劉真道。

translations.literal: Zhang Senkai's Collation Notes say: "This should read Liu Zhendao, as in the biography of Liu Huaisu; in year eighteen below it likewise reads Liu Zhendao.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Senkai's Collation Notes say it should read Liu Zhendao, as in Liu Huaisu's biography; year eighteen below also has Liu Zhendao.

sentences.zh: 」按張說是，今改正。

translations.literal: " Zhang's view is correct; the text is now corrected.
translations.idiomatic: " Zhang is correct; the text is now corrected.

sentences.zh: 河南國河西王訶羅單國並遣使獻方物 「河西王」各本並作「西河王」，據少帝紀及大沮渠蒙遜傳改。

translations.literal: "The state of Henan, the King of Hexi, and the state of Heluodan all sent envoys presenting local products": all editions read "King of Xihe" for "King of Hexi"; emended according to the Annals of the Deposed Emperor and the biography of Juqu Mengxun.
translations.idiomatic: "The state of Henan, the King of Hexi, and the state of Heluodan all sent envoys bearing tribute": all editions have "King of Xihe" instead of "King of Hexi"; corrected per the Deposed Emperor's annals and Juqu Mengxun's biography.

sentences.zh: 燕王弘遣使獻方物 「弘」各本並作「年」，據晉書載記改。

translations.literal: "King Hong of Yan sent envoys presenting local products": all editions read "nian" for "Hong"; emended according to the Annals in the Book of Jin.
translations.idiomatic: "King Hong of Yan sent envoys bearing tribute": all editions read nian instead of Hong; corrected per the Book of Jin annals.

sentences.zh: 今年有不收處 「年」各本並作「半」，據元龜四八九改。

translations.literal: For the phrase "where there is no harvest this year," all editions read ban for nian; emended according to Yuan Gui 489.
translations.idiomatic: For the phrase "where there is no harvest this year," all editions read ban (half) instead of nian (year); corrected per Yuan Gui 489.

sentences.zh: 以光祿大夫王球為尚書僕射 「王球」各本並作「王琳」，據南史、通鑑改。

translations.literal: "Special Grand Master Wang Qiu was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat": all editions read "Wang Lin" for "Wang Qiu"; emended according to the Book of Southern Qi and Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: "Special Grand Master Wang Qiu was appointed Vice Director of the Secretariat": all editions read Wang Lin instead of Wang Qiu; corrected per the Book of Southern Qi and Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 洪頤煊諸史考異云：「王球作王琳，是傳寫之譌。」

translations.literal: Hong Yixuan's Collation of Discrepancies among the Histories says: "Wang Qiu written as Wang Lin is a corruption in transmission."
translations.idiomatic: Hong Yixuan's Collation of Discrepancies among the Histories notes: Wang Qiu written as Wang Lin is a scribal error.

sentences.zh: 夏五月壬午 「壬午」各本作「壬申」。

translations.literal: "In the fifth month of summer, on renwu": all editions read "renshen" for "renwu."
translations.idiomatic: "In the fifth month of summer, on renwu": all editions read renshen instead of renwu.

sentences.zh: 局本作「壬午」。

translations.literal: The Bureau edition reads "renwu."
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau edition reads renwu.

sentences.zh: 按是月壬午朔，無壬申。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month began on renwu — there was no renshen.
translations.idiomatic: That month began on renwu; there was no renshen.

sentences.zh: 今從局本。

translations.literal: The Bureau edition is now followed.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau edition is now followed.

sentences.zh: 尚書僕射王球卒 「球」各本並作「琳」，據南史、通鑑改。

translations.literal: "Vice Director of the Secretariat Wang Qiu died": all editions read "Lin" for "Qiu"; emended according to the Book of Southern Qi and Comprehensive Mirror.
translations.idiomatic: "Vice Director of the Secretariat Wang Qiu died": all editions read Lin instead of Qiu; corrected per the Book of Southern Qi and Comprehensive Mirror.

sentences.zh: 是月 各本並作十二月。

translations.literal: "In this month": all editions read "twelfth month."
translations.idiomatic: "In this month": all editions read twelfth month.

sentences.zh: 按上已有十月，十一月，十二月，不當重出十二月。

translations.literal: Above there are already the tenth, eleventh, and twelfth months — the twelfth month should not appear again.
translations.idiomatic: The tenth, eleventh, and twelfth months already appear above; twelfth month should not recur.

sentences.zh: 今改作是月。

translations.literal: The text is now emended to read "this month."
translations.idiomatic: Emended to read "this month."

sentences.zh: 盛王聖世 「聖」各本並作「祖」，據元龜一九四改。

translations.literal: For the phrase "a flourishing age under a sage ruler," all editions read zu for sheng; emended according to Yuan Gui 194.
translations.idiomatic: For the phrase "a flourishing age under a sage ruler," all editions read zu (ancestor) instead of sheng (sage); corrected per Yuan Gui 194.

sentences.zh: 始奉礿祠 「礿」各本並作「初」，據元龜二０七改。

translations.literal: For the phrase "first performed the yue sacrifice," all editions read chu instead of yue; emended according to Yuan Gui 207.
translations.idiomatic: For the phrase "first performed the yue sacrifice," all editions read chu instead of yue; corrected per Yuan Gui 207.

sentences.zh: 庚申 各本同。

translations.literal: For the date gengshen, all editions agree.
translations.idiomatic: For the date gengshen, all editions agree.

sentences.zh: 按是月壬申朔，初三日甲戌，是月無庚申。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month began on renshen; the third day was jiaxu — there was no gengshen in that month.
translations.idiomatic: That month began on renshen; the third day was jiaxu. There was no gengshen that month.

sentences.zh: 下有甲申，為十三日。

translations.literal: Below there is "jiashen," which would be the thirteenth day.
translations.idiomatic: Below appears jiashen, which would be the thirteenth day.

sentences.zh: 甲戌、甲申之間有庚辰。

translations.literal: Between jiaxu and jiashen there would be gengchen.
translations.idiomatic: Between jiaxu and jiashen there should be gengchen.

sentences.zh: 庚申疑庚辰之譌。

translations.literal: Gengshen is likely a corruption of gengchen.
translations.idiomatic: Gengshen is likely a corruption of gengchen.

sentences.zh: 南徐南豫州揚州之浙江西 各本同。

translations.literal: For the phrase "the lands west of the Zhe River in Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and Yang provinces," all editions agree.
translations.idiomatic: For the phrase "the lands west of the Zhe River in Southern Xu, Southern Yu, and Yang provinces," all editions agree.

sentences.zh: 南史於「南徐」下有「南兗」二字。

translations.literal: The Book of Southern Qi has the two characters "Southern Yan" after "Southern Xu."
translations.idiomatic: The Book of Southern Qi adds "Southern Yan" after "Southern Xu."

sentences.zh: 南豫州刺史武陵王駿加撫軍將軍 「駿」各本作「贊」，三朝本作「諱」。

translations.literal: "Governor of Southern Yu Province Prince of Wuling Liu Jun was additionally appointed Pacifying-Army General": all editions read "Zan" for "Jun"; the Three Dynasties edition reads the taboo form.
translations.idiomatic: "Governor of Southern Yu Province Prince of Wuling Liu Jun was additionally appointed Pacifying-Army General": all editions read Zan instead of Jun; the Three Dynasties edition uses the taboo form.

sentences.zh: 按時武陵王駿，即後之孝武帝。

translations.literal: At this time Prince of Wuling Liu Jun was the future Emperor Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: At this time Prince of Wuling Liu Jun was the future Emperor Xiaowu.

sentences.zh: 贊為宋明帝第九子，後亦封武陵王，時尚未生。

translations.literal: Zan was the ninth son of Emperor Ming of Song and was later also enfeoffed as Prince of Wuling, but had not yet been born.
translations.idiomatic: Zan was Emperor Ming's ninth son and would later also be enfeoffed as Prince of Wuling, but had not yet been born.

sentences.zh: 今改作「駿」。

translations.literal: The text is now emended to read "Jun."
translations.idiomatic: Emended to read Jun.

sentences.zh: 征北將軍南徐州刺史南譙王義宣為車騎將軍荊州刺史 「南徐州刺史」各本並脫「南」字，據義宣傳補。

translations.literal: "Campaigning-North General and Governor of Southern Xu Province Prince of Nanqiao Liu Yixuan was appointed Chariots-and-Cavalry General and Governor of Jing Province": all editions omit "Southern" before Xu Province; restored according to the biography of Liu Yixuan.
translations.idiomatic: "Campaigning-North General and Governor of Southern Xu Province Prince of Nanqiao Liu Yixuan was appointed Chariots-and-Cavalry General and Governor of Jing Province": all editions drop Southern before Xu Province; restored from Liu Yixuan's biography.

sentences.zh: 九月己未 「己未」各本並作「乙未」，局本作「己未」。

translations.literal: "In the ninth month, on jiwei": all editions read "yimou" for "jiwei"; the Bureau edition reads "jiwei."
translations.idiomatic: "In the ninth month, on jiwei": all editions read yimou instead of jiwei; the Bureau edition reads jiwei.

sentences.zh: 按是月丁巳朔，初三日己未，無乙未。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month began on dingsi; the third day was jiwei — there was no yimou.
translations.idiomatic: That month began on dingsi; the third day was jiwei. There was no yimou.

sentences.zh: 今從局本。

translations.literal: The Bureau edition is now followed.
translations.idiomatic: The Bureau edition is now followed.

sentences.zh: 遷漢川流民於沔次 「漢川」各本作「漢州」，按時無「漢州」，據元龜四八六改。

translations.literal: "The Han River migrants were relocated to the banks of the Mian": all editions read "Hanzhou" for "Hanchuan"; there was no "Hanzhou" at the time — emended according to Yuan Gui 486.
translations.idiomatic: "The Han River migrants were relocated to the banks of the Mian": all editions read Hanzhou instead of Hanchuan; there was no Hanzhou at the time — corrected per Yuan Gui 486.

sentences.zh: 三月丁巳 下有乙丑。

translations.literal: "In the third month, dingsi": below this there is "yichou."
translations.idiomatic: "In the third month, dingsi": yichou appears below.

sentences.zh: 各本同。

translations.literal: All editions agree.
translations.idiomatic: All editions agree.

sentences.zh: 按是月丁卯朔，無丁巳，亦無乙丑。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month began on dingmao — there was neither dingsi nor yichou.
translations.idiomatic: That month began on dingmao; there was neither dingsi nor yichou.

sentences.zh: 四月丙申朔，二十二日丁巳，三十日乙丑。

translations.literal: The fourth month began on bingchen; the twenty-second day was dingsi, the thirtieth yichou.
translations.idiomatic: The fourth month began on bingchen; the twenty-second day was dingsi and the thirtieth yichou.

sentences.zh: 辛亥 各本並作「辛巳」。

translations.literal: For the date xinhai, all editions read xinsi.
translations.idiomatic: For the date xinhai, all editions read xinsi.

sentences.zh: 通鑑考異云：「按長曆，二月壬辰朔，十日辛丑，二十日辛亥。

translations.literal: The Comprehensive Mirror's Collation of Discrepancies says: "According to the long calendar, the second month began on renchen; the tenth day was xinchou, the twentieth xinhai.
translations.idiomatic: The Comprehensive Mirror's Collation of Discrepancies says: by the long calendar, the second month began on renchen; the tenth day was xinchou and the twentieth xinhai.

sentences.zh: 辛巳當作辛亥。

translations.literal: Xinsi should read xinhai.
translations.idiomatic: Xinsi should read xinhai.

sentences.zh: 」今據改。

translations.literal: " The text is now emended accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: " Emended accordingly.

sentences.zh: 安北將軍徐兗二州刺史武陵王駿降號鎮軍將軍 「駿」宋本作「諱」。

translations.literal: "General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces Prince of Wuling Liu Jun was reduced in rank to General Who Stabilizes the Army": the Song edition reads the taboo form for "Jun."
translations.idiomatic: "General Who Pacifies the North and Governor of Xu and Yan provinces Prince of Wuling Liu Jun was reduced in rank to General Who Stabilizes the Army": the Song edition uses the taboo form for Jun.

sentences.zh: 三朝本、北監本、毛本、殿本作「贊」，今據孝武帝紀訂正。

translations.literal: The Three Dynasties, Northern Directorate, Mao, and Palace editions read "Zan"; now corrected according to the Annals of Emperor Xiaowu.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Dynasties, Northern Directorate, Mao, and Palace editions read Zan; corrected per the Annals of Emperor Xiaowu.

sentences.zh: 說見本卷校勘記第三十條。

translations.literal: The explanation is given in collation note thirty of this fascicle.
translations.idiomatic: See collation note thirty in this fascicle.

sentences.zh: 五月乙酉亡命司馬順則自號齊王據梁鄒城丁巳婆皇國戊戌河南王並遣使獻方物 按是年五月甲申朔，初二日乙酉，十五日戊戌，無丁巳。

translations.literal: "On yiyou in the fifth month the outlaw Sima Shunze declared himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou; on dingsi the state of Pohuang, and on wuxu the King of Henan, all sent envoys presenting local products": according to the calendar, the fifth month that year began on jiashen; the second day was yiyou, the fifteenth wuxu — there was no dingsi.
translations.idiomatic: "On yiyou in the fifth month the outlaw Sima Shunze declared himself King of Qi and seized Liangzou; on dingsi Pohuang, and on wuxu the King of Henan, sent envoys bearing tribute": that year's fifth month began on jiashen; the second day was yiyou and the fifteenth wuxu — there was no dingsi.

sentences.zh: 丁巳日支當有誤。

translations.literal: The date dingsi must be in error.
translations.idiomatic: The dingsi date must be wrong.

sentences.zh: 居業未立 「立」各本並作「能」，據元龜一九五改。

translations.literal: For the phrase "their livelihoods were not yet established," all editions read neng instead of li; emended according to Yuan Gui 195.
translations.idiomatic: For the phrase "their livelihoods were not yet established," all editions read neng (able) instead of li (established); corrected per Yuan Gui 195.

sentences.zh: 戊午 各本並作「庚午」，據南史改。

translations.literal: For the date wuwu, all editions read gengwu; emended according to the Book of Southern Qi.
translations.idiomatic: For the date wuwu, all editions read gengwu; corrected per the Book of Southern Qi.

sentences.zh: 按是月庚戌朔，無庚午。

translations.literal: According to the calendar, that month began on gengxu — there was no gengwu.
translations.idiomatic: That month began on gengxu; there was no gengwu.

sentences.zh: 初九日戊午。

translations.literal: The ninth day was wuwu.
translations.idiomatic: The ninth day was wuwu.
